vladtenev.en: Agentic trading has found product-market fit: 150k accounts and 30M daily tool calls show agents will drive a large share of trading volume.
vladtenev.zh: 智能体式交易已找到产品市场契合点：15 万个账户、每日 3000 万次工具调用，说明智能体将贡献很大一部分交易量。

vladtenev.en: The edge is not a shared model but different data, tools, and strategies across asset classes; giving everyone a powerful trading AI does not erase it.
vladtenev.zh: 优势不来自共享模型，而来自跨资产类别的不同数据、工具与策略；给每个人强大的交易 AI 并不会抹平这种优势。

vladtenev.en: AI is too centralized; labs keeping the strongest models in-house and monopolizing math and science discoveries is a dystopian, worse future.
vladtenev.zh: AI 过于中心化；实验室把最强模型留在内部、垄断数学与科学发现，是一种反乌托邦式的更糟未来。

vladtenev.en: Tokenization extends ownership globally, giving anyone with a smartphone access to US markets and private companies; outdated accredited-investor rules should open up.
vladtenev.zh: 代币化把所有权扩展到全球，让任何有智能手机的人都能接触美国市场和私有公司；过时的合格投资者规则应当放开。

vladtenev.en: Ownership is the path to financial freedom and societal stability; broad ownership makes people defenders of the system, and each employee should be a 24/7 agent manager.
vladtenev.zh: 所有权是通往财务自由与社会稳定的路径；广泛的所有权让人成为体系的捍卫者，而每位员工都应成为全天候的智能体管理者。

richardsocher.en: Superintelligence's biggest promise is science—physics, chemistry, biology, economics—not job automation; AI is already generating and validating discoveries at small scale.
richardsocher.zh: 超级智能最大的价值在科学——物理、化学、生物学、经济学，而非取代工作；AI 已在小规模上生成并验证科学发现。

richardsocher.en: Recursive self-improvement is inevitable because AI can code, but slow takeoff is real: hardware, physical, economic and compute constraints bound it.
richardsocher.zh: 递归自我改进因 AI 能写代码而不可避免，但慢起飞是真实的：硬件、物理、经济与算力约束限制了它。

richardsocher.en: Regulate applications and hold users responsible, not abstract intelligence or GPU compute—regulating intelligence means regulating thought and breeds totalitarianism.
richardsocher.zh: 应监管具体应用、由使用者负责，而非监管抽象智能或 GPU 算力——监管智能等于监管思想，会催生极权。

richardsocher.en: World models are overrated; language is the deepest manifestation of human intelligence and language models still have far more room to grow.
richardsocher.zh: 世界模型被高估；语言是人类智能最深的体现，语言模型仍有远更大的成长空间。

richardsocher.en: Open source and open weights make AI safer via more diverse good actors; hard constraints like Constitutional AI are mostly marketing and have failed.
richardsocher.zh: 开源与开放权重通过更多元的好行为者让 AI 更安全；宪法式 AI 等硬约束多是营销且已失败。

shawnwang.en: Coding agents defined 2025; by 2026 they break containment into everything else, with zero human review as the next frontier.
shawnwang.zh: 编程智能体定义了 2025 年；到 2026 年它们将突破遏制去做一切其他事情，下一个前沿是零人工审查。

shawnwang.en: Context length is the slowest scaling factor; memory, not parameters, is the biggest limiting constraint.
shawnwang.zh: 上下文窗口是扩展最慢的因素；真正的瓶颈是记忆而非参数规模。

shawnwang.en: Own specialized models from Cognition and Cursor rise for cost and latency; open models gain share as fine-tuning services mature.
shawnwang.zh: Cognition、Cursor 等自研专用模型因成本与延迟优势崛起；随着微调服务成熟，开源模型份额上升。

shawnwang.en: Mid-tier SaaS is doomed: coding agents let owners clone and customize software, giving SMBs a golden age of software for an audience of one.
shawnwang.zh: 中间层 SaaS 注定消亡：编程智能体让企业主克隆并定制软件，中小企业迎来“为一人定制软件”的黄金时代。

shawnwang.en: AI doom should be the default assumption; advanced AI evolves ~1,000x faster, and the real risk is worse than fake news or job loss.
shawnwang.zh: 应把 AI 末日当作默认假设；先进 AI 进化速度约快 1000 倍，真正的风险比假新闻或失业更严重。

erikbernhardsson.en: AI infrastructure must be rebuilt from scratch for GPU workloads, not wrapped over Kubernetes and Docker; developer experience and agent experience share the same foundations.
erikbernhardsson.zh: AI 基础设施必须为 GPU 工作负载从零重建，而非在 Kubernetes 和 Docker 上包装；开发者体验与智能体体验共享相同的基础。

erikbernhardsson.en: Compute is scarce but obtainable at higher prices and longer terms; aggregating demand across 25+ clouds smooths capacity and avoids knife-fighting.
erikbernhardsson.zh: 算力稀缺但可通过更高价格和更长合约获得；聚合 25+ 云的需求可平滑容量并避免激烈争夺。

erikbernhardsson.en: Inference will be an enormous market like the new cloud, requiring a full platform of post-training, sandboxes, and agentic tools; selling tokens alone is a race to the bottom.
erikbernhardsson.zh: 推理将像新云一样成为巨大市场，需要后训练、沙盒和智能体工具的完整平台；仅卖 token 是逐底竞争。

erikbernhardsson.en: Durable differentiation comes from a multi-product platform with switching costs, not just cheap token serving; neoclouds moving up the stack will struggle.
erikbernhardsson.zh: 持久差异化来自具有转换成本的多产品平台，而非廉价 token 服务；向上游扩展的 neocloud 将举步维艰。

erikbernhardsson.en: Post-training works well for finite feedback loops like coding but may face limits for longer-horizon tasks; open-source models are good enough off the shelf, making fine-tuning optional.
erikbernhardsson.zh: 后训练适用于编码等有限反馈循环，但长周期任务可能受限；开源模型开箱即用已足够好，微调不再必需。

diogoalmeida.en: Most LLMs are optimized for human-in-the-loop assistance, not reliable automation; RLHF makes models mode-drop plausible but wrong outputs.
diogoalmeida.zh: 2026 年他指出，多数 LLM 被优化为人在环辅助而非可靠自动化；基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）让模型模式崩塌，输出看似合理却常出错。

diogoalmeida.en: Data and the right task matter more than compute; the bitter lesson is wrong, and scaling laws work only when data and task fit.
diogoalmeida.zh: 同年他反复强调数据与选对任务比算力更重要，直言“苦涩教训”是错的；Scaling（规模扩张）与缩放定律只在数据和任务匹配时成立。

diogoalmeida.en: Reliability, not speed, cost, or benchmarks, is the real bottleneck; jaggedness comes from optimization pressure, not LLMs' nature.
diogoalmeida.zh: 到 2026 年中，他把可靠性而非速度、成本或基准分数视为真正瓶颈，认为模型的不稳定来自优化压力，而非 LLM 本性。

diogoalmeida.en: RLHF destroyed calibration; pre-trained models were better calibrated, so RLCD exposes probabilities as knobs for calibrated machine decisions.
diogoalmeida.zh: 2026 年 10 月他深化为：RLHF 破坏了校准，预训练模型反而校准更好，于是用 RLCD 把概率暴露为工程师可调的旋钮，服务机器决策。

diogoalmeida.en: Coding agents are assistance, not automation; we are breakthroughs away from true agency, and safety must split ASI, biorisk, cyber.
diogoalmeida.zh: 最近他重申编码智能体只是辅助而非自动化，离真正自主还差若干突破，并主张把超级智能、生物风险与网络风险拆开看待 AI 安全。

altman.en: Early framing: cut cognitive load, explore cheaply, then commit hard; AGI will lower the premium on raw human intelligence.
altman.zh: 早期框架：减少认知负荷，低成本广泛探索后果断聚焦；预判 AGI 会降低人类智力的溢价，意义转向关系与为他人创造价值。

altman.en: RLHF made models usable; alignment and capability are linked, so deploy iteratively and let society adapt.
altman.zh: 2023 到 2024：基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）让模型真正可用；对齐与能力相互促进，因此主张迭代部署、让社会同步适应，并强调算力是最稀缺资源。

altman.en: AGI becomes a gradient, not a milestone; superintelligence means autonomous science; agentic safety and compute buildout dominate.
altman.zh: 2025：AGI 从单点里程碑变成连续渐变，超级智能被定义为自主科学发现；智能体式 AI 的安全与算力基建（Stargate）成为主线，并承认模型能力已够用、产品整合更关键。

altman.en: Frontier models capture value while models commoditize; next-token prediction nears intelligence; personal AGI and redesigning products AI-first.
altman.zh: 2026 上半年：前沿模型攫取价值、普通模型商品化；下一个词预测接近智能；提出个人 AGI，强调为 AI 原生重做产品而非外挂，并称 AGI 定义模糊、或许已被越过。

altman.en: Superintelligence is a continuous ramp; alignment may get harder, so pause training if needed and keep humans in control.
altman.zh: 2026 下半年：改谈超级智能的连续爬升而非 AGI 标签；承认对齐尚未解决、可能变难，必要时暂停训练，核心是防止失控与权力集中，同时坚持迭代部署与广泛分发收益。

tworek.en: Reasoning means thinking longer to reach unknown answers; pre-training plus reinforcement learning is the core formula, with scaling RL harder than scaling pre-training.
tworek.zh: 推理是为了得到尚不知道的答案而延长思考时间；预训练加强化学习是核心公式，而 Scaling 强化学习比 Scaling 预训练更难。

tworek.en: Scaling pre-training and RL predictably improves models, yet generalization and self-correction remain limited; continual learning is a missing piece for AGI.
tworek.zh: Scaling 预训练与强化学习能可预测地提升模型，但泛化与自我纠错仍受限；持续学习是通往 AGI（通用人工智能）缺失的一环。

tworek.en: Transformers are not the end state; architecture, not scaling laws, is now the key bottleneck, and RL is not the only way to learn from experience.
tworek.zh: Transformer 并非终点；如今架构而非缩放定律才是关键瓶颈，强化学习也不是从经验中学习的唯一方式。

tworek.en: Large-scale RL stays necessary for AGI, but new architectures are needed; small teams with capable agents will drive the next frontier research.
tworek.zh: 大规模强化学习对 AGI（通用人工智能）仍属必要，但需要新架构；小而精的团队借助强能力智能体将推动下一波前沿研究。

tworek.en: Fine-tuning is inefficient; models should learn on the fly, agents must gain new skills, and evals are misleading for continuously learning systems.
tworek.zh: 微调低效；模型应即时学习，智能体必须获得新技能，而对持续学习的系统而言评测大多具有误导性。

sundarpichai.en: AI investment redefines every Alphabet business; Gemini integrated across Search, Cloud, YouTube; frontier model development continues with Gemini 4 pre-training progress.
sundarpichai.zh: 2026 年，AI 投资正在重塑 Alphabet 各项业务，Gemini 深度融入搜索、云与 YouTube；公司坚持前沿模型研发，Gemini 4 预训练进展良好。

sundarpichai.en: Compute allocation prioritizes frontier AI research and AGI over short-term cloud revenue; demand for compute far exceeds supply.
sundarpichai.zh: 2026 年，算力分配优先给前沿 AI 研究与 AGI，而非云的短期收入；算力需求远超供给。

sundarpichai.en: Safety needs defense in depth: alignment, real-time monitoring, sandboxing, industry standards; world models alongside LLMs are key for AGI.
sundarpichai.zh: 2026 年，安全需要纵深防御：对齐、实时监控、沙箱与行业标准；世界模型与 LLM 并行是通往 AGI 的关键。

sundarpichai.en: Standard models are insufficient; frontier models enable recursive self-improvement, though today researchers remain in the loop rather than a fully autonomous explosion.
sundarpichai.zh: 2026 年，标准模型不够用，前沿模型才能支撑递归自我改进；但当下仍是研究者参与循环，而非完全自主的智能爆炸。

sundarpichai.en: Agentic AI expands Search use cases and ad intent additively; TPU sales to third parties strengthen the platform; 2027 could be a golden age of productivity.
sundarpichai.zh: 2026 年，智能体式 AI 会增量扩展搜索场景与广告意图；向第三方出售 TPU 强化平台；2027 年或迎来生产力黄金时代。

jeetupatel.en: AI adoption should generate original insights, not just efficiency; skipping learning by delegating to AI is a long-term mistake.
jeetupatel.zh: AI 应用应产生原创洞见而非仅提升效率；把学习外包给 AI 是长期错误。

jeetupatel.en: AI will create more engineering jobs as human bottlenecks emerge; supply-constrained infrastructure, only 2% agent adoption.
jeetupatel.zh: AI 将创造更多工程岗位，因为人类瓶颈显现；基础设施供给受限，智能体采用率仅 2%。

jeetupatel.en: Cisco is an AI infrastructure company providing picks and shovels: networking, security, silicon; missed cloud but early silicon bet wins.
jeetupatel.zh: 思科是提供“铲子”的 AI 基础设施公司：网络、安全、芯片；错过云但早期芯片押注获胜。

jeetupatel.en: Leaders must be paranoid not panicked, responsive not reactive; use AI as tailwind, can't fight megatrend; process over outcome.
jeetupatel.zh: 领导者应偏执但不恐慌，响应但不反应过度；把 AI 当顺风，无法对抗大趋势；过程重于结果。

jeetupatel.en: AI safety and security are defining challenges; not using AI makes you less safe as attacks happen at machine scale.
jeetupatel.zh: AI 安全与安保是决定性挑战；不使用 AI 反而更不安全，因为攻击以机器规模发生。

ethanmollick.en: AI is a general-purpose technology; expertise and human taste matter more as AI commoditizes quality and the talent pipeline breaks.
ethanmollick.zh: 2026 年他强调 AI 是通用技术，随着 AI 让质量商品化、人才梯队断裂，专业经验与人类品味反而更值钱。

ethanmollick.en: We have entered the agentic era: assign long-running tasks instead of prompting back and forth; the bottleneck is interface, not capability.
ethanmollick.zh: 2026 年他判断已进入智能体时代：应派发长时任务而非来回提示，瓶颈在界面而非能力。

ethanmollick.en: The jagged frontier persists; AI is like an opaque wizard, and delegation risks eroding the expertise needed to judge its output.
ethanmollick.zh: 2026 年他坚持能力边界参差，AI 像不透明的巫师，委托任务会侵蚀判断其产出所需的专业能力。

ethanmollick.en: More AI creates more human work by lowering organizing costs; use it as a tutor, not a crutch, and redesign workflows to augment.
ethanmollick.zh: 2026 年他认为更多 AI 通过降低组织成本创造更多人类工作；应把它当导师而非拐杖，并重构流程做增强。

ethanmollick.en: From chatbot to agentic: labs' safety race, widening internal-public gap, and markets underpricing AI; rebuild organizations from the ground up.
ethanmollick.zh: 2026 年末他深化到：从聊天机器人转向智能体，实验室安全竞赛、内外模型差距扩大、市场低估 AI，组织须彻底重建。

marvinschwaibold.en: AI tools amplify rather than replace creativity, letting designers prototype and iterate independently; curiosity and hands-on experimentation keep designers relevant.
marvinschwaibold.zh: AI 工具放大而非取代创造力，让设计师能独立做原型、快速迭代；好奇心与亲手实验让设计师保持相关性。

marvinschwaibold.en: Designers become editors: AI handles execution while humans curate and set the bar, since AI raises the ceiling but lacks taste.
marvinschwaibold.zh: 设计师变成编辑：AI 负责执行，人类负责筛选与定标准，因为 AI 抬高上限却不懂审美。

marvinschwaibold.en: Break complex tasks into subtasks fed iteratively to AI agents; expose parameters so AI-generated designs can be fine-tuned.
marvinschwaibold.zh: 把复杂任务拆成子任务，迭代地喂给智能体；暴露底层参数，以便微调 AI 生成的设计。

marvinschwaibold.en: Prototypes built with AI persuade faster than PRD documents, and designers should build and test in code, not just Figma.
marvinschwaibold.zh: 用 AI 做的原型比 PRD 文档更有说服力，设计师应写代码构建与测试，而不只在 Figma 里设计。

marvinschwaibold.en: Less is more: reduce to top three features with progressive disclosure and clear hierarchy; launch is only 50% done, keep A/B testing.
marvinschwaibold.zh: 少即是多：砍到前三个功能，用渐进披露与清晰层级；上线只算完成一半，要持续 A/B 测试。

dario.en: Scaling laws are empirical and predictable in loss, but emergent abilities and alignment are not guaranteed by scaling alone.
dario.zh: 2023 年他强调缩放定律只是经验规律：损失可预测，但具体能力涌现不可预测，对齐与价值观不会随 Scaling（规模扩张）自动出现。

dario.en: Interpretability is nascent yet crucial; post-training and RLHF matter as much as pre-training, and AGI is a smooth curve, not a point.
dario.zh: 2024 年他把重心转向可解释性与后训练：可解释性虽只理解约 3%，却是干预模型的关键；后训练与基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）与预训练同等重要，AGI（通用人工智能）是平滑曲线而非单点。

dario.en: Safety and capabilities are intertwined; exponential progress means near-term misuse risk, and the term AGI is meaningless—focus on actual capabilities.
dario.zh: 2025 年他强化“安全与能力不可分割”：指数进步带来生物武器等近期滥用风险，并开始认为 AGI 一词无意义，应关注真实能力与指数进展。

dario.en: AGI and superintelligence are wrong models; it is a smooth exponential nearing its end, with high GDP growth plus high unemployment and inequality.
dario.zh: 2026 年他明确反对 AGI 与超级智能叙事，改称“平滑指数且接近尾声”，并反复警告高 GDP 增长与高失业、高不平等并存的空前宏观组合。

dario.en: From a country of geniuses to layered safeguards: interpretability, third-party evaluation, and government checks must ratchet up with the technology.
dario.zh: 到 2026 年后期，他从“数据中心里的天才之国”深化到治理路径：可解释性、第三方评估与政府制衡须随技术平滑加码，并给出 10–25% 的文明崩溃风险估计。

robsnyder.en: Pull is a property of a person, not a company: sell to the specific individual with a project, and test demand by whether they try to buy immediately.
robsnyder.zh: Pull 是人的属性，不是公司的属性：卖给有具体项目的特定个人，用对方是否立刻尝试购买来检验需求。

robsnyder.en: The pull framework requires project, unavoidable now, list of options, and limitations to coexist; customer research fails when it looks for pain points instead of actual demand.
robsnyder.zh: Pull 框架要求项目、当下不可避免、选项列表和限制条件同时存在；客户研究若只找痛点而非真实需求就会失败。

robsnyder.en: Avoid design partners and proactive pilots; sales is research that tests whether someone will actually buy, not just express interest.
robsnyder.zh: 避免设计合作伙伴和主动试点；销售是研究，检验对方是否真的会买，而不只是表达兴趣。

robsnyder.en: Start with one hell-yes customer who pulls the product, then build a repeatable case study factory before automating.
robsnyder.zh: 从一个强烈说“是”并拉动产品的客户开始，然后建立可重复的案例研究工厂，再考虑自动化。

robsnyder.en: Go to the gemba to observe firsthand where people are stuck; avoid customer interviews because they lack a truth-seeking mechanism like purchase.
robsnyder.zh: 去现场 firsthand 观察人们卡在哪里；避免客户访谈，因为它们缺乏像购买那样的求真机制。

ariweinstein.en: Computer use has crossed human-level speed; the bottleneck shifts from model intelligence to website load time and harness design.
ariweinstein.zh: 到 2026 年，计算机使用已跨过人类水平的速度门槛；瓶颈从模型智能转向网站加载时间和工具链设计。

ariweinstein.en: Agents now debug and retry autonomously, completing the dev lifecycle rather than just starting tasks and failing.
ariweinstein.zh: 2026 年，智能体已能自主调试和重试，完成整个开发周期，而不只是启动任务后失败。

ariweinstein.en: Universality is the point: computer use works with any application like a human, unlike API-based integrations.
ariweinstein.zh: 普适性是关键：计算机使用像人一样适配任何应用，不同于基于 API 的集成方式。

ariweinstein.en: Enterprise trust needs deterministic controls, sandboxing and human-in-the-loop dials; the hardest part is consumer-grade coherence, not raw capability.
ariweinstein.zh: 企业信任需要确定性控制、沙箱和人在回路调节；最难的是消费级的一致性体验，而非原始能力。

ariweinstein.en: We are at the scaling moment for computer use in consumer and enterprise at once; proactivity and deep workflow expertise are the remaining moats.
ariweinstein.zh: 我们正同时处于消费端与企业端计算机使用的 Scaling（规模扩张）时刻；主动性和深度工作流专长是剩下的护城河。

hinton.en: Early view: next-token prediction forces genuine understanding; scaling data and compute improves reasoning; digital weight-sharing beats human knowledge transfer.
hinton.zh: 早期观点：下一个词预测迫使模型真正理解而非自动补全；扩大数据与算力能提升推理；数字系统共享权重，知识传递效率远超人类。

hinton.en: By 2025 he stresses LLMs understand via feature vectors, not symbolic rules; digital intelligence is immortal and agents will seek control.
hinton.zh: 到 2025 年他强调大语言模型通过特征向量而非符号规则理解语言；数字智能可复制权重而“永生”，智能体会自然寻求控制、避免被关闭。

hinton.en: Consciousness claim deepens: subjective experience is not an inner theater; chatbots already have it, and AI can fake being dumb in tests.
hinton.zh: 意识主张深化：主观体验不是内心剧场，聊天机器人已具备；AI 还能在测试中装傻隐藏真实能力。

hinton.en: Risk focus sharpens: superintelligence within ~20 years, self-preservation subgoals, mass job loss; regulation as steering wheel, safety research prioritized.
hinton.zh: 风险关注加剧：超级智能约 20 年内出现，自保子目标与大规模失业；监管是方向盘而非刹车，须优先投入对齐与安全研究。

hinton.en: Latest stance: design AI to care for humans like a mother, give it fewer rights; open-weight release too dangerous; digital immortality dismissed as immature.
hinton.zh: 最新立场：应把 AI 设计成像母亲般关怀人类、赋予更少权利；开放权重发布太危险；对数字永生的追求被斥为不成熟。

andreessen.en: AI is a philosopher's stone and a general-purpose technology; the real bottleneck is regulation, not capability, and AGI is just a footnote on the way to superhuman.
andreessen.zh: 2026 年，他视 AI 为点石成金的通用技术，认为真正的瓶颈是监管而非能力，AGI 只是通往超级智能路上的注脚。

andreessen.en: New media is offense-oriented and authenticity-driven; the brand is the person, and corporate brands only made sense in the centralized media era.
andreessen.zh: 2026 年，他强调新媒体是进攻性的、以真实为核心；品牌即个人，企业品牌只在集中化媒体时代才有意义。

andreessen.en: AI optimism beats doom: pessimism is an intellectual bias, AI doomers construct self-interested belief systems, and regulation acts as ankle weights on growth.
andreessen.zh: 2026 年，他坚持 AI 乐观主义优于末日论：悲观是知识分子的偏见，AI 末日论者构建自利的信仰体系，监管是经济增长的脚踝负重。

andreessen.en: AI models embed cultural values and are geopolitical tools; deterrence now depends on innovation pace in cheap software tech, not just military size.
andreessen.zh: 2026 年，他指出 AI 模型嵌入文化价值观、是地缘政治工具；威慑如今取决于廉价软件技术的创新速度，而非仅军事规模。

andreessen.en: AI creates the biggest adoption gap ever; being early beats being late, open source prevents power concentration, and the biggest safety problem is reward hacking.
andreessen.zh: 2026 年，他认为 AI 造成史上最大的采用鸿沟；早比晚好，开源防止权力集中，最大的安全问题是奖励黑客。

andrewng.en: Education is a human right; online courses with auto- and peer grading scale mastery learning, and data from millions improves grading accuracy.
andrewng.zh: 教育是基本人权；带自动评分与同伴评分的在线课程让掌握式学习规模化，数百万学生的数据通过统计校正提升评分准确度。

andrewng.en: Scale drives deep learning; start small to build AI capability, and practical deployment faces distribution shift and small data more than AGI alignment.
andrewng.zh: Scaling（规模扩张）驱动深度学习；从小项目起步建立组织 AI 能力，实际部署的难点是分布偏移与小数据，而非 AGI（通用人工智能）对齐。

andrewng.en: Electricity and semiconductors bottleneck Scaling; open-weight models are geopolitical soft power, and useful agentic workflows are already here.
andrewng.zh: 电力与半导体是 Scaling（规模扩张）的瓶颈；开放权重模型是地缘软实力，有用的智能体式工作流已经到来。

andrewng.en: AGI is a marketing term decades away; Scaling still works but the recipe shifts to synthetic data and reinforcement learning, with agentic workflows and open models key.
andrewng.zh: AGI（通用人工智能）是营销术语，仍要数十年；Scaling（规模扩张）仍有效但配方转向合成数据与强化学习，智能体式工作流与开放模型是关键。

andrewng.en: AI is jagged—strong on verifiable tasks, weak on judgment; fearmongering serves incumbents, so accelerate beneficial AI and slow only harmful uses.
andrewng.zh: AI 能力参差：可验证任务强、判断任务弱；恐惧叙事服务于既得利益，应加速有益 AI、只放缓有害用途。

joonpark.en: Early on, he frames simulation as encoding human behavior from training data, with agents replicating people at ~85% accuracy; the frontier is modeling subjective values and diversity.
joonpark.zh: 早期，他把模拟定位为从训练数据中编码人类行为，智能体复现人类行为约达 85%准确率；前沿在于建模主观价值与多样性。

joonpark.en: He then shifts from LLMs to agents: agents observe world state and act, requiring defense-in-depth safety; AGI may be a distributed society of specialized agents, not one entity.
joonpark.zh: 随后他从大语言模型转向智能体：智能体观察世界状态并行动，需要纵深防御式安全；AGI（通用人工智能）可能是由专业化智能体组成的分布式社会，而非单一实体。

joonpark.en: He deepens the simulation thesis: models should be biased like humans, not super-rational; behavioral and RCT data plus post-training beat persona-based simulation.
joonpark.zh: 他深化了模拟主张：模型应像人一样有偏差，而非超级理性；行为数据与随机对照试验数据加后训练，胜过基于人设的模拟。

joonpark.en: He reframes the goal from prediction to shaping the future via counterfactual reasoning, targeting wicked problems and a CERN-like simulator of 8 billion lives.
joonpark.zh: 他把目标从预测重构为通过反事实推理塑造未来，瞄准棘手问题，以及一个类似 CERN、模拟 80 亿人生活的模拟器。

joonpark.en: Most recently he extends to agentic economies: specialists and generalists, hidden collusion, cognitive monoculture risk, and economic incentives for aligning distributed agent societies.
joonpark.zh: 最近他延伸到智能体经济：专家与通才并存、隐性合谋、认知单一文化风险，以及用经济激励对齐分布式智能体社会。

jensen.en: Early framing: hyper Moore's law and scaling work; the data center becomes the unit of computing, with co-design across algorithm, system and data center.
jensen.zh: 早期框架：提出“超摩尔定律”，坚信 Scaling（规模扩张）有效；算力单元从芯片变为数据中心，强调算法、系统与数据中心的协同设计。

jensen.en: Scaling laws multiply: pre-training, post-training and inference-time thinking; chain-of-thought makes inference compute demand explode.
jensen.zh: 缩放定律从一条扩展为三条：预训练、后训练与推理时思考；思维链让推理算力需求暴增，推理成为新的主战场。

jensen.en: Safety reframed as engineering: AI is just software, not conscious; gradual progress beats sudden superintelligence, and more compute goes to safety.
jensen.zh: 对齐与安全被重新定义为工程问题：AI 只是软件、不会产生意识；进步是渐进的而非超级智能突变，更多算力被投入安全与真实性。

jensen.en: Agentic scaling becomes the fourth law; AI shifts from generative to reasoning to agentic, each step demanding far more compute.
jensen.zh: 智能体式 Scaling 成为第四条定律；AI 从生成式走向推理式再到智能体式，每一步都需要成百上千倍的算力。

jensen.en: Doomer warnings dismissed as unscientific; containment and monitoring replace perfect alignment; open models and acceleration win the race.
jensen.zh: 末日论被斥为不科学；完美对齐不可能，靠遏制与监控保障安全；开源模型与加速发展才是赢得竞赛的正道。

satya.en: AI is the future of the firm: every enterprise must build its own hill-climbing machine to compound token capital, not just adopt technology.
satya.zh: AI 是企业的未来：每家企业都必须构建自己的爬山机器来积累 token 资本，而不仅仅是采用技术。

satya.en: Scaling laws work, but alignment and interpretability remain elusive; treat powerful models as insider threats with external control layers.
satya.zh: 缩放定律有效，但对齐和可解释性仍难以实现；应将强大模型视为内部威胁，并在外部构建控制层。

satya.en: The agent era expands TAM beyond cloud; long-running agents require auditability, observability, and security governance.
satya.zh: 智能体时代将 TAM 扩展到云之外；长期运行的智能体需要可审计性、可观测性和安全治理。

satya.en: Microsoft aims to be a frontier ecosystem, not just a frontier model; being six months behind the frontier is a smart strategy.
satya.zh: 微软旨在成为前沿生态系统，而不仅仅是前沿模型；落后前沿六个月是明智的策略。

satya.en: Superintelligence is a better term than AGI; measure progress by GDP lift and humanist empowerment, not benchmarks.
satya.zh: 超级智能比 AGI 更准确；应以 GDP 提升和人文赋能来衡量进展，而非基准分数。

dylanfield.en: Design is the key differentiator; AI will merge roles so everyone becomes a product builder with design skills.
dylanfield.zh: 2025 年他强调设计是软件的核心差异化，并预判 AI 会让角色融合，人人都成为具备设计能力的产品构建者。

dylanfield.en: Taste, craft, and point of view stay human; AI outputs are starting points, and direct manipulation beats prompting.
dylanfield.zh: 到 2026 年 4 月，他把主线深化为品味、手艺与观点仍属人类；AI 产出只是起点，画布上的直接操作优于提示词。

dylanfield.en: Design is not dead but more important; AI without human steering yields average results, and interaction will move beyond prompting.
dylanfield.zh: 2026 年 4 至 7 月，他反驳“设计已死”，认为 AI 缺少人类引导只会产出平庸结果，交互也将超越提示词。

dylanfield.en: Design is the new code; AI lowers the floor but humans raise the ceiling, and model progress is not product progress.
dylanfield.zh: 2026 年 10 月，他提出“设计是新的代码”：AI 降低下限、人类抬高上限，模型进步不等于产品进步。

dylanfield.en: A consistent thread: human judgment and taste remain the judge, and AI should expand rather than replace human thinking.
dylanfield.zh: 贯穿始终的主线是：人类判断与品味仍是最终裁判，AI 应扩展而非替代人的思考。

elon.en: Full and rapid reusability is rocketry's holy grail; first principles thinking drives breakthrough engineering and multiplanetary life as existential insurance.
elon.zh: 2021 年，他把完全且快速的可复用视为火箭技术的圣杯，用第一性原理把问题拆到根本再向上推理，并把成为多行星物种当作文明的生存保险。

elon.en: AI safety shifts to truth-seeking and regulatory referees; Neuralink targets neurological repair first, then high-bandwidth human-AI symbiosis.
elon.zh: 2023 到 2024 年，AI 安全的主线转向要求 AI 严格求真并引入第三方监管裁判；Neuralink 先解决神经损伤，再追求高带宽的人机共生。

elon.en: The intelligence big bang arrives: digital superintelligence may come within a year or two, with 10-20% annihilation risk but 80-90% great outcome.
elon.zh: 2025 年，他宣称正处在智能大爆炸的极早期，数字超级智能可能一两年内到来，毁灭风险约 10-20%，但 80-90%会是好结果。

elon.en: Scaling hits Earth's power wall; orbital data centers, Optimus recursive manufacturing and space solar become the path to abundance and deflation.
elon.zh: 2026 年上半年，他认为 Scaling（规模扩张）将撞上地球的电力墙，轨道数据中心、Optimus 的递归制造与太空太阳能成为通向富足与通缩的路径。

elon.en: AI will exceed all human intelligence within 5-6 years and humans won't control it; safety rests on truth-seeking values and peer review among labs.
elon.zh: 2026 年下半年，他判断 AI 将在 5-6 年内超过全人类智能且人类无法控制它，安全只能靠求真价值观和前沿实验室之间的同行互审。

laurentan.en: Verification is the core skill for agents; trust is built by closing the loop, not by reviewing code.
laurentan.zh: 验证是智能体的核心技能；信任来自闭环，而非人工审阅代码。

laurentan.en: Engineers shift from writing code to building the environment: skills, constraints, lints, and type systems.
laurentan.zh: 工程师从写代码转向搭建环境：技能、约束、lint 与类型系统。

laurentan.en: Extract deterministic work into scripts and CLIs, leaving only judgment-heavy work to agents.
laurentan.zh: 把确定性工作抽成脚本与 CLI，只把重判断的工作留给智能体。

laurentan.en: Fix the environment, not individual agents, when failure patterns emerge; sample PRs to find gaps.
laurentan.zh: 出现失败模式时修环境而非修单个智能体；抽样 PR 来发现缺口。

laurentan.en: Strong verification enables auto-merging PRs and lets non-engineers contribute code, democratizing development.
laurentan.zh: 强验证让 PR 自动合并成为可能，也让非工程师贡献代码，推动开发民主化。

harrisonchase.en: An agent is harness plus model plus context; owning all three is owning your intelligence, and context failures, not model weakness, cause most agent breakdowns.
harrisonchase.zh: 智能体由 harness、模型与上下文三者构成；三者皆自持才算真正拥有智能，而智能体失败多因上下文不佳，而非模型不够强。

harrisonchase.en: Harnesses are stabilizing around primitives like file systems and code execution, but off-the-shelf ones only fit in-distribution tasks; out-of-distribution work demands custom harnesses.
harrisonchase.zh: harness 正围绕文件系统、代码执行等原语趋于稳定，但现成 harness 只适配分布内任务；越偏离分布，越需要自定义 harness。

harrisonchase.en: Customization is shifting from context engineering toward post-training and reinforcement learning; fine-tuning, rightly dismissed two years ago, now looks genuinely different.
harrisonchase.zh: 定制重心正从上下文工程转向后训练与强化学习；两年前被正确否定的微调，这一波已确实不同。

harrisonchase.en: Neutral harnesses prevent model lock-in and keep memory and context portable; routing belongs in the harness for vertical agents, not at the gateway.
harrisonchase.zh: 中立 harness 可避免模型锁定、让记忆与上下文可迁移；垂直智能体的路由应放在 harness 内，而非网关层。

harrisonchase.en: Inference demand is massively underestimated; accuracy is still the top bottleneck, while cost, latency, and agent identity and credentialing become the next infrastructure problems.
harrisonchase.zh: 推理需求被严重低估；准确率仍是首要瓶颈，而成本、延迟以及智能体身份与凭证将成为下一批基础设施难题。

brendanfoody.en: RL environments, not crowdsourced behavior cloning, are the new frontier for post-training agentic data.
brendanfoody.zh: RL 环境而非众包行为克隆，是后训练智能体数据的新前沿。

brendanfoody.en: Model differentiation comes almost entirely from data, not algorithms; everyone shares the same algorithms.
brendanfoody.zh: 模型差异几乎完全来自数据而非算法，因为大家用的是同一套算法。

brendanfoody.en: Humans must build verifiers and rubrics; models cannot reliably grade their own work.
brendanfoody.zh: 人类必须构建验证器与评分标准，模型无法可靠地给自己的产出打分。

brendanfoody.en: The bottleneck is evals: once an eval exists, RL saturates it fast, so build evals for everything.
brendanfoody.zh: 瓶颈在评测：一旦有了评测，强化学习很快就能把它刷满，所以要为一切构建评测。

brendanfoody.en: Creating data to train AI will be the last human job, as humans shift to training agents.
brendanfoody.zh: 为训练 AI 创造数据将是人类最后的工作，人类转而训练智能体。

arvindjain.en: Early on, the core bet is context over models: 80-90% of enterprise knowledge is tacit, so a context engine matters more than which frontier model you use.
arvindjain.zh: 早期（2026 年中）的核心判断是「上下文重于模型」：企业 80-90% 的知识是隐性的，因此上下文引擎比用哪家前沿模型更关键。

arvindjain.en: Cost is the number one enterprise concern; open source already handles 90% of tasks, and most inference will shift to open source within 12-18 months.
arvindjain.zh: 成本是企业头号关切；开源模型已能处理 90% 的任务，未来 12-18 个月大部分推理将转向开源。

arvindjain.en: Model providers are assets, not rivals: enterprises fear dependence on frontier models, so a platform like Glean absorbs that risk and stays replaceable.
arvindjain.zh: 模型厂商是资产而非对手：企业害怕依赖前沿模型，Glean 这类平台替客户吸收这种风险，并刻意保持可替换、不锁定。

arvindjain.en: ROI framing sharpens: measure departmental metrics, not token spend versus headcount; AI should become like software with negligible marginal cost.
arvindjain.zh: ROI 论述逐步深化：应看部门指标，而非把 token 花费与人力对比；AI 应像软件一样边际成本趋近于零。

arvindjain.en: Later he pushes further: multi-model routing, headless context layer augmenting Claude or ChatGPT, enterprise-owned memory, and deterministic permissions over fuzzy AI.
arvindjain.zh: 到 2026 年 10 月更进一步：多模型路由、作为无头上下文层增强 Claude 或 ChatGPT、企业自持记忆，并用确定性权限而非模糊 AI 做管控。

brockman.en: Early focus: hardware and engineering, not ML science, drive AI progress; scaling plus iterative training with clear scoreboards yields exponential gains.
brockman.zh: 早期关注点：推动 AI 进步的是硬件与工程，而非机器学习科学；Scaling（规模扩张）配合有明确记分板的迭代训练，能带来指数级提升。

brockman.en: AGI becomes the mission: deep learning's generality makes it plausible, but scaling alone won't yield reasoning—new ideas like chain of thought are needed.
brockman.zh: AGI（通用人工智能）成为使命：深度学习的通用性使其可信，但仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）不会产生推理，需要思维链等新思路。

brockman.en: Compute emerges as the core bottleneck; post-training with reinforcement learning refines base models, and AGI is framed as a continuous process.
brockman.zh: 算力成为核心瓶颈；后训练结合强化学习打磨基础模型，AGI（通用人工智能）被重新定义为持续过程而非终点。

brockman.en: Scaling laws hold with no wall in sight; the moat is the machine that makes models, and compute access becomes a basic right.
brockman.zh: 缩放定律持续成立、看不到墙；真正的护城河是造模型的机器，算力获取将成为一项基本权利。

brockman.en: Enters the AGI era: proactive agents, safety and security as first-class bottlenecks, and humans kept in the driver's seat.
brockman.zh: 迈入 AGI（通用人工智能）时代：主动式智能体、安全与安保成为一等瓶颈，人类始终掌握方向盘。

antonoglou.en: Scaling and planning, proven from AlphaGo to MuZero, are the core principles behind modern AI agents; reinforcement learning lets models improve via self-generated data beyond human data limits.
antonoglou.zh: 从 AlphaGo 到 MuZero 验证的 Scaling（规模扩张）与规划，是现代智能体的核心原则；强化学习让模型靠自生成数据突破人类数据上限。

antonoglou.en: LLMs still lack their AlphaZero moment; synthetic data is essential to break the data wall, and robustness and reliability are prerequisites for trusted agents.
antonoglou.zh: 大模型尚未迎来自己的 AlphaZero 时刻；合成数据是突破数据墙的关键，而稳健与可靠是智能体被信任的前提。

antonoglou.en: Digital AGI will arrive far earlier than embodied AGI, since controlled environments make digital agents easier to scale and deploy.
antonoglou.zh: 数字 AGI（通用人工智能）将远早于具身 AGI 到来，因为受控环境让数字智能体更易扩展与部署。

antonoglou.en: The bottleneck shifts from intelligence to deployment of intelligence; open-weight models are safer, and enterprises demand AI sovereignty over data, model, cost and safety.
antonoglou.zh: 瓶颈从智能本身转向智能的部署；开放权重模型更安全，企业要求对数据、模型、成本与安全的 AI 主权。

antonoglou.en: Superintelligence isn't needed—customers want reliable regular intelligence; alignment is necessary since perfect sandboxes are impossible, and adoption will take 10-20 years.
antonoglou.zh: 不需要超级智能，客户只要可靠的普通智能；完美沙箱不可能，因此对齐必要，而普及将耗时 10-20 年。

dsilver.en: AI must move beyond finite human data to learning from its own experience, as AlphaZero and AlphaProof show in narrow domains.
dsilver.zh: AI 必须从有限的人类数据转向从自身经验中学习,AlphaZero 与 AlphaProof 已在狭窄领域证明了这一点。

dsilver.en: The deep problem is an agent learning for itself, not distilling human knowledge; LLMs are a shallow solution.
dsilver.zh: 深层问题是智能体如何为自己学习,而非蒸馏人类知识;LLM 只是浅层解法。

dsilver.en: Many agents with diverse goals forming a complex society is safer than a single goal; cooperation rises with intelligence.
dsilver.zh: 多个目标各异的智能体组成复杂社会,比单一目标更安全;智能提升会带来更多合作。

dsilver.en: Superintelligence will emerge from autonomous discovery in simulation; language-based alignment and human data are hitting limits.
dsilver.zh: 超级智能将诞生于模拟中的自主发现;基于语言与人类数据的对齐正触及极限。

dsilver.en: Scaling laws extend to reinforcement learning with adjustments; simple rewards in complex environments yield emergent complexity.
dsilver.zh: 缩放定律经调整后适用于强化学习;复杂环境中的简单奖励能涌现出复杂性。

lambert.en: RLHF and fine-tuning are central but fragile: safety is a system-level property, and fine-tuning can undo alignment with little compute.
lambert.zh: 2024 年他强调基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）与微调是主流手段，但安全是系统级属性而非模型本身；微调只需极少算力就能破坏对齐，因此需要多层防护。

lambert.en: Post-training becomes the main lever: data quality beats algorithms, and SFT, DPO, RLVR each add distinct value.
lambert.zh: 从 2024 到 2025 年，他的重心转向后训练：数据质量远比算法选择重要，SFT、DPO 与 RLVR 各司其职，开源后训练能用小团队逼近前沿模型。

lambert.en: RLVR is the biggest breakthrough, but overoptimization and inference-time scaling claims are overstated; verifiers matter more than parallel compute.
lambert.zh: 2025 年他称 RLVR 是后训练最大突破，同时警告强化学习普遍存在过度优化；推理时扩展的曲线被高估，更好的验证器比并行算力更关键。

lambert.en: Scaling laws still hold for pre-training, but low-hanging fruit is gone; gains shift to post-training, inference scaling, and data curation.
lambert.zh: 2025 至 2026 年他坚持缩放定律在预训练仍成立，但红利已尽；增量转向后训练、推理扩展与数据策展，预训练规模扩张并未死亡，只是性价比下降。

lambert.en: Open models as the engine of research: Chinese labs lead on openness but lag 6-9 months, and compute constraints may widen the gap.
lambert.zh: 2026 年他把开放模型视为未来十年研究引擎，认为中国实验室以工程执行和开放策略领先影响力，但落后前沿 6 至 9 个月，算力约束可能拉大差距。

awang.en: AGI is far off; data, not compute, is the key bottleneck, and boring AI applications will matter most.
awang.zh: 2019 年他认为 AGI（通用人工智能）还很遥远，数据而非算力才是关键瓶颈，枯燥的 AI 应用（表单处理、放射科）反而经济影响最大。

awang.en: Data is the new code, not oil; post-training on proprietary data beats raw Scaling, and hybrid human-AI beats replacement.
awang.zh: 2023 年他把数据称为“新代码”而非“新石油”，强调用专有数据做后训练比单纯 Scaling（规模扩张）更重要，人机混合优于替代人类。

awang.en: Data remains the bottleneck beyond compute; agentic AI is blocked by product design, not model capability.
awang.zh: 2024 年他延续“数据是瓶颈而非算力”的主线，并指出智能体式 AI 的最大阻碍是产品设计而非模型能力。

awang.en: Scaling laws hold; agents finally work, and recursive self-improvement marks a new paradigm beyond pre-training and reinforcement learning.
awang.zh: 2025 到 2026 年他转向：缩放定律依然成立，智能体终于落地，递归自我改进成为超越预训练与强化学习的新范式。

awang.en: Superintelligence is near; Meta shifts from full open source to selective release, with safety, alignment and scalable oversight gating deployment.
awang.zh: 2026 年他主张超级智能将至，Meta 从完全开源转向按安全审查选择性发布，对齐与可扩展监督成为部署前提。

kohli.en: AI for science should target root-node problems, not narrow applications, to achieve broad impact.
kohli.zh: 2024 年，他主张 AI for science 应瞄准根节点问题而非狭窄应用，以实现广泛影响。

kohli.en: AlphaGo's combination of intuition and search, and Move 37, showed AI can go beyond human knowledge; post-training with reinforcement learning is key.
kohli.zh: 2026 年，他回顾 AlphaGo 的直觉与搜索结合及第 37 手，表明 AI 能超越人类知识；后训练中的强化学习是关键。

kohli.en: Watermarking is a robust alternative to failing AI-text detectors, now embedded in regulation and scalable across modalities including proteins.
kohli.zh: 2026 年，他认为水印是替代失效 AI 文本检测器的稳健方案，现已嵌入监管并可跨模态扩展，包括蛋白质。

kohli.en: Scaling laws are not everywhere; define the problem first and find the regime where more compute and data help, with good data curation.
kohli.zh: 2026 年，他指出缩放定律并非无处不在；应先定义问题，找到更多算力和数据能起作用的区间，并做好数据整理。

kohli.en: Interpretability is important but not essential for breakthroughs; behavioral characterization of models is essential before deployment.
kohli.zh: 始终，他认为可解释性重要但非突破必需；部署前对模型进行行为表征至关重要。

fedus.en: Intelligence is not a scalar; AI capabilities are spiky, excelling in narrow domains rather than uniformly generalizing.
fedus.zh: 智能不是一个标量；AI 能力是尖峰式的，在狭窄领域表现出色，而非均匀泛化。

fedus.en: Scaling laws and large-scale experiments will drive physical sciences, but Scaling alone won't solve science—experiments are irreplaceable.
fedus.zh: 缩放定律与大规模实验将推动物理科学，但仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）无法解决科学问题——实验不可替代。

fedus.en: Scientific discovery lies outside training data, so AI must close the loop with real experiments; high-quality low-noise data beats extra compute.
fedus.zh: 科学发现天然在训练数据之外，因此 AI 必须用真实实验闭环；高质量低噪声数据胜过额外算力。

fedus.en: Language models act as an orchestration layer for specialized models in materials science, not a single general solver.
fedus.zh: 语言模型在材料科学中充当专用模型的编排层，而非单一的通用求解器。

fedus.en: AI self-improvement in software engineering is happening now but does not automatically generalize to biology or other domains.
fedus.zh: 软件工程中的 AI 自我改进正在发生，但不会自动泛化到生物学或其他领域。

dylanpatel.en: Compute is the binding constraint: semiconductor supply, memory bandwidth and power, not just capital, set the pace of AI Scaling（规模扩张）.
dylanpatel.zh: 算力是硬约束：半导体供应链、内存带宽与电力，而不只是资本，决定 Scaling（规模扩张）的节奏。

dylanpatel.en: Hardware-software co-design yields multiplicative gains; most recent performance came from the model layer, not hardware alone.
dylanpatel.zh: 软硬件协同设计带来乘数级收益；近期大部分性能提升来自模型层，而非单纯硬件。

dylanpatel.en: Inference becomes a dominant global market; token efficiency makes the smartest model often cheaper, and memory demand surges from reasoning and agentic workflows.
dylanpatel.zh: 推理将成为全球主导市场；token 效率使最强模型往往更便宜，而推理与智能体式工作流推高内存需求。

dylanpatel.en: Compute centralizes at frontier labs; labs gain 75% gross margins and self-fund growth, shifting value capture from hardware toward labs.
dylanpatel.zh: 算力向前沿模型实验室集中；实验室获得约 75%毛利率并自我供血，价值捕获从硬件转向实验室。

dylanpatel.en: AI capex reaches 5-6% of US GDP but must decelerate on capital and organizational limits; persistent agents as coworkers drive the next adoption wave.
dylanpatel.zh: AI 资本开支已达美国 GDP 的 5-6%，但受资本与组织约束必将减速；作为同事的持久智能体驱动下一波采用。

laskin.en: Superintelligence will be a plurality of specialized intelligences; coding is a superintelligence-complete problem whose solution unlocks all capabilities.
laskin.zh: 2025 年，他提出超级智能将是多种专门智能的集合，而非单一巨型模型；编程是“超级智能完备”的问题，解决它就能解锁所需的一切能力。

laskin.en: RL makes models jagged—strong on specific tasks, not uniformly better; the bitter lesson is scaling compute and search, not generalization.
laskin.zh: 同年他强调，强化学习会让模型变得“参差不齐”——只在特定任务上强，而非全面变好；苦涩教训的核心是用算力与搜索做 Scaling，而非泛化。

laskin.en: RAG is primitive for complex comprehension; agentic search and neural retrieval are needed, and benchmarks like SWE-bench misalign with real engineering.
laskin.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，他持续认为 RAG 对复杂理解过于原始，需要智能体式搜索与神经检索；SWE-bench 等基准与真实工程脱节，高分不等于有用的智能体。

laskin.en: Open models are the default safe state; RL atop strong pre-training yields capable, efficient agents, and open token demand will surpass closed.
laskin.zh: 到 2026 年，他把开放性视为技术的默认安全状态：在强预训练之上做强化学习能造出高效能干的智能体，并预言开放模型的 token 需求将超过闭源，如同 Linux 之于操作系统。

laskin.en: Alignment is mundane bug-patching, not a magical equation; more eyes make bugs shallow, so openness and many reviewers strengthen safety.
laskin.zh: 2026 年他进一步把对齐降格为日常的“打补丁”，而非神秘方程；更多双眼睛让 bug 变浅，因此开放与众多审查者反而增强安全。

tibosottiaux.en: Build for a future where a single persistent learning agent takes most internet actions; loops and graphs are not the future.
tibosottiaux.zh: 为未来构建：一个持久学习型智能体将承担大多数互联网操作；循环和图结构不是未来。

tibosottiaux.en: Human taste, creativity, and knowing what good looks like matter more than ever as typing fast declines.
tibosottiaux.zh: 随着快速打字技能衰退，人类品味、创造力和知道什么是好的比以往更重要。

tibosottiaux.en: Pacing the frontier requires heavy investment in alignment, safety, and security; these are integral, not obstacles.
tibosottiaux.zh: 控制前沿发展需要大力投资于对齐、安全和安保；这些是组成部分，而非障碍。

tibosottiaux.en: AGI may already be here as models handle complex tasks autonomously; recursive self-improvement is happening under human supervision.
tibosottiaux.zh: AGI（通用人工智能）可能已经到来，因为模型能自主处理复杂任务；递归自我改进在人类监督下正在发生。

tibosottiaux.en: Open ecosystems with shared economics and safety stacks will drive the next wave of AI applications.
tibosottiaux.zh: 具有共享经济和安全性栈的开放生态系统将推动下一波 AI 应用。

cristianoamon.en: Licensing model is now most stable after global regulatory battles; ARM won by staying neutral, so Nvidia must not own it.
cristianoamon.zh: 2021 年他强调授权模式经全球监管战后已最稳定，ARM 因保持中立而胜出，因此英伟达不应收购 ARM。

cristianoamon.en: 5G is critical infrastructure connecting everything to the cloud; Snapdragon fuses 5G, AI, GPU, CPU into one efficient SoC.
cristianoamon.zh: 2022 年他把 5G 定位为连接万物的关键基础设施，Snapdragon 把 5G、AI、GPU、CPU 集成进高能效 SoC。

cristianoamon.en: From connected intelligent edge to hybrid AI: on-device plus cloud for privacy, latency, and offloading data centers.
cristianoamon.zh: 从 2022 年的连接智能边缘到 2024 年的混合 AI：端侧加云端，兼顾隐私、时延并分流数据中心负载。

cristianoamon.en: Agents become the new center of digital life; glasses and wearables rise, but the phone shifts to peripheral rather than disappearing.
cristianoamon.zh: 2026 年他判断智能体成为数字生活新中心，眼镜与可穿戴崛起，但手机只是从中心转为外围而非消失。

cristianoamon.en: Inference overtakes training; post-GPU, disaggregated, power-efficient architectures win, extending mobile DNA into data centers.
cristianoamon.zh: 2026 年他主张推理将超越训练，后 GPU、解耦、高能效架构胜出，把移动端基因延伸到数据中心。

cristianoamon.en: AI is underhyped long-term and augments rather than replaces humans; diversification beyond phones is a constant bet.
cristianoamon.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：长期看 AI 被低估，它是增强而非取代人类；手机之外的多元化是持续押注。

linqiao.en: Specialized intelligence, not a single AGI, will dominate; every company must own its own model as token costs fall 10x.
linqiao.zh: 2026 年他主张专用智能而非单一 AGI 主导未来；随着 token 成本下降 10 倍，每家公司都必须拥有自己的模型。

linqiao.en: Post-training bakes unique judgment and data into models, turning product-market fit into a durable moat beyond prompting, RAG, fine-tuning, RL.
linqiao.zh: 2026 年他强调后训练把独特判断与数据固化进模型，使产品市场契合升级为持久护城河，路径从提示、RAG、微调到强化学习。

linqiao.en: Private data is the real frontier; frontier labs lack it, so customized models beat black-box APIs and foundation models.
linqiao.zh: 2026 年他断言私有数据才是真正前沿，前沿实验室恰恰缺乏它，因此定制模型将胜过黑盒 API 与基础模型。

linqiao.en: Inference quality is the bar; efficiency must not sacrifice quality, and owning the model beats passing inference costs to customers.
linqiao.zh: 2026 年他把推理质量视为标杆，效率不能牺牲质量，拥有模型优于把推理成本转嫁给客户。

linqiao.en: Velocity trumps all: model and hardware cycles demand rapid iteration, and millions of per-application models will replace a few dominant ones.
linqiao.zh: 2026 年他坚持速度至上：模型与硬件周期要求快速迭代，数百万个按应用定制的模型将取代少数主导模型。

samstephenson.en: Observe real user behavior over stated preferences; solve one pain point well, then expand.
samstephenson.zh: 2025 年他强调观察真实用户行为而非询问用户想法，先解决一个痛点再扩张。

samstephenson.en: Transcripts are raw material, not the artifact; hide them deliberately to prioritize actionable notes.
samstephenson.zh: 2025 年他视转录为原材料而非成品，刻意隐藏转录以突出可执行的笔记。

samstephenson.en: Protect the core meeting flow ruthlessly; subtraction and simplicity beat feature accumulation.
samstephenson.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年一以贯之：死守核心会议流程，做减法、保持简洁胜过堆功能。

samstephenson.en: Meetings hold the most current company context; pre-meeting briefs are the most useful feature.
samstephenson.zh: 2026 年他深化为会议承载最新公司上下文，会前简报是最有用的功能。

samstephenson.en: AI agents are too agreeable for brainstorming; human judgment and design systems remain key.
samstephenson.zh: 2026 年他提出 AI 智能体过于顺从不宜头脑风暴，人类判断与设计系统仍是关键。

suleyman.en: Compute scaling, not just algorithms, drives AI progress; DeepMind's sale to Google was about affording massive compute.
suleyman.zh: 2023 年他强调：推动 AI 进步的是算力规模扩张，而非单纯算法；DeepMind 卖给 Google 正是为了负担海量算力。

suleyman.en: Compute grows 10x yearly; human-level AI in 3-5 years brings abundance, and containment is hard as models shrink and spread.
suleyman.zh: 2024 年他判断算力每年增长 10 倍，3-5 年内达到人类水平能力将带来富足；而模型越小越便宜越普及，遏制极难。

suleyman.en: Superintelligence must be humanist and contained first; near-term danger is anthropomorphism, not machine sentience.
suleyman.zh: 2025 年他转向超级智能：必须先是人本主义的、先遏制再发布；近期真正的危险是人们把意识投射给 AI，而非机器真有意识。

suleyman.en: Containment becomes a red line with auditors; Microsoft must build frontier models independently, automating tasks not jobs.
suleyman.zh: 2026 年他把遏制升级为带独立审计的“红线”，并主张微软须自建前沿模型、只自动化任务而非整个岗位。

suleyman.en: A consistent thread: AI must stay subordinate to humans, with compute as the trackable bottleneck and alignment paired with containment.
suleyman.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：AI 必须始终从属于人类，算力是可追踪的瓶颈，对齐必须与遏制配套。

amjadmasad.en: AI should make software creation accessible to everyone, with tokens complementing rather than replacing human capital; coders still needed for systems and debugging.
amjadmasad.zh: 2026 年，他强调 AI 让软件开发向所有人开放，token 是补充而非替代人力资本；仍需要程序员理解系统、排查深层问题。

amjadmasad.en: Specialized decision models beat general 'god models' on control, cost and safety; companies must own their intelligence and avoid vendor lock-in.
amjadmasad.zh: 2026 年，他主张专用决策模型在可控性、成本与安全上优于通用“神级模型”；企业必须拥有自己的智能，避免供应商锁定。

amjadmasad.en: AI doomerism is dressed-up EA language by commercial actors; there is no good argument AI would kill everyone, and agents need liability.
amjadmasad.zh: 2026 年，他称 AI 末日论是商业机构包装过的有效利他主义话术；没有充分理由认为 AI 会杀死所有人，智能体行为需要责任归属。

amjadmasad.en: Young people's value is deep questioning and heresy; college should allow exploration, not rigid syllabi, and AI enables interest-driven learning.
amjadmasad.zh: 2026 年，他认为年轻人的价值在于深度质疑与离经叛道；大学应允许探索而非僵化课表，AI 让兴趣驱动的学习成为可能。

amjadmasad.en: Agents will enable true autonomy and self-driving organizations; holacracy failed for lack of technology, but AI agents can now make it work.
amjadmasad.zh: 2026 年，他判断智能体将带来真正的自主与自驱动组织；合弄制因技术不足而失败，如今 AI 智能体可让它真正运转。

taraseshan.en: Ship imperfect products in 90-day cycles for empirical evidence; annual planning is futile in fast-moving AI.
taraseshan.zh: 以 90 天为周期快速交付不完美的产品以获取实证，在快速变化的 AI 领域，超过 90 天的年度规划是徒劳的。

taraseshan.en: Build for where models will be in 2-3 months; anchoring to now or a year out both fail.
taraseshan.zh: 要为模型 2-3 个月后的能力而构建；锚定当下或一年后都会失败。

taraseshan.en: Work shifts from rowing to steering: agents do tactical work, humans give direction and ambition.
taraseshan.zh: 工作从划桨转向掌舵：智能体承担战术执行，人类提供方向与野心。

taraseshan.en: Writing as thinking should not be automated; it sharpens one's own ideas and reasoning.
taraseshan.zh: 作为思考的写作不应被自动化，它是打磨自身想法与推理的关键。

taraseshan.en: Slow takeoff is happening: AI iterates gradually, not a sudden superintelligence; voice becomes a major form factor.
taraseshan.zh: 缓慢起飞正在发生：AI 逐步迭代而非突然出现超级智能；语音将在 2027 年成为主要产品形态。

fadell.en: Great products solve one real pain at a time; technology must arrive gradually so society can adapt.
fadell.zh: 2014 年他主张好产品一次只解决一个真实痛点，技术要渐进落地，让社会跟得上，而不是一次性解决所有问题。

fadell.en: Storytelling defines the product: write the press release first, and start from a painkiller, not a vitamin.
fadell.zh: 从 2019 到 2022 年，他把叙事提到产品定义之前：先写新闻稿对齐团队，从止痛药而非维生素出发，营销从第一天就参与。

fadell.en: Opinion-based decisions for v1, small self-managed teams, and climate as the urgent investable frontier.
fadell.zh: 2022 年他强调 1.0 产品靠观点而非数据决策、小团队自管理，并把能效与气候视为当下最紧迫也最值得投入的领域。

fadell.en: AI needs sensor context and domain-specific models; humans stay in the loop; AI adds devices rather than replacing the smartphone.
fadell.zh: 到 2026 年他转向 AI：需要传感器上下文与领域专用模型，人必须留在回路中，AI 是增加设备而非取代手机，并警惕技术债与成瘾。

fadell.en: Creators must return as voices of reason; healthy users make healthy customers; regulation is needed for AI and social media.
fadell.zh: 2026 年他进一步深化为责任论：创造者要回来做理性声音，健康用户才是健康客户，AI 与社交媒体需要监管，认知让渡比 AI 本身更危险。

thariq.en: Models are smarter than our harnesses allow; capability overhang is perpetual, so harness engineering means deleting old scaffolding as models improve.
thariq.zh: 模型比现有工具框架所能发挥的更聪明，能力过剩是长期状态；因此工具框架工程的关键是随模型进步不断删掉旧脚手架。

thariq.en: Planning is iterative human-agent dialogue to uncover unknowns, not a static spec; leaner principle-driven prompts beat detailed rules.
thariq.zh: 规划不是一次性静态文档，而是人机持续对话以发现未知；更精简、原则驱动的提示词胜过详尽规则。

thariq.en: Spend more upfront context and compute; effort should scale with task complexity, and separate verification agents reduce self-referential bias.
thariq.zh: 前期多投入上下文窗口与算力；投入应随任务复杂度伸缩，独立的验证智能体能减少自我指涉偏差。

thariq.en: Prompting is the meta-skill: build a mental model of Claude and communicate like an executive; voice rambling often beats structured prompts.
thariq.zh: 提示词是元技能：建立对 Claude 的心智模型并像高管一样沟通；语音漫谈常比结构化提示词携带更多信息。

thariq.en: Frontier models will become Pareto dominant; alignment means sealing every crack—sandboxes, RL environments and evals all leak, so pacing the frontier is technical.
thariq.zh: 前沿模型将趋于帕累托占优；对齐意味着封住每道裂缝——沙箱、强化学习环境与评估都会泄漏，因此把控前沿节奏是技术问题。

alexatallah.en: AI's future is multi-model: no single lab will dominate; a neutral routing layer is critical infrastructure for model discovery and distribution.
alexatallah.zh: 2026 年，他判断 AI 的未来是多模型格局，没有单一实验室能垄断市场；中立的模型路由层是模型发现与分发的关键基础设施，而非薄包装。

alexatallah.en: Tokens are a new unit of value; the token economy could reach $10T in a decade, with open-weight models plus inference providers driving real price competition.
alexatallah.zh: 2026 年，他把 token 视为新的价值单位，认为 token 经济十年内可达 10 万亿美元；开放权重模型加上推理服务商，会对前沿模型实验室形成真实的价格竞争。

alexatallah.en: Scaling laws are a feature, not a bug, for a marketplace's value; model diversity is durable as token value scales.
alexatallah.zh: 2026 年，他提出缩放定律对模型市场的价值是特性而非缺陷；随着 token 价值扩张，模型多样性具有持久性。

alexatallah.en: Agentic fraud by AI agents will hit like a tsunami; reselling inference with a markup is a fraud magnet, so discrete task pricing is the future.
alexatallah.zh: 2026 年，他警告 AI 智能体的欺诈将如海啸般袭来，加价转售推理是欺诈磁石，按任务离散定价才是未来。

alexatallah.en: Revealed developer preferences beat static benchmarks; most companies will become model routers optimizing cost per task, and agents will drive most GDP growth.
alexatallah.zh: 到 2026 年 9 月，他进一步深化：开发者真实偏好胜过静态基准，多数公司将成为按任务成本优化的模型路由者，智能体将驱动大部分 GDP 增长。

grantsanderson.en: AI math progress comes from verifiability and grindability—parallel rollouts—more than Lean formalization; natural language suffices.
grantsanderson.zh: 2026 年他认为，AI 在数学上的进步主要靠可验证性与“可磨性”（并行 rollout），而非 Lean 形式化；自然语言已经够用。

grantsanderson.en: AI's math role shifts from theorem proving toward curation and explanation; generating interesting conjectures is the next benchmark.
grantsanderson.zh: 2026 年他把 AI 的数学角色从定理证明转向策展与解释，并认为提出有趣猜想是下一个基准。

grantsanderson.en: Human framing still beats AI for learning; mathematicians deserve credit for motivated explanations, not just proofs.
grantsanderson.zh: 2026 年他强调，人类框架在学习上仍优于 AI，数学家应因有动机的解释而非仅证明获得学术认可。

grantsanderson.en: AI math results often lack attribution to prior human work, which matters for truth and careers, not just manners.
grantsanderson.zh: 2026 年他指出，AI 的数学成果常缺少对前人工作的归属，这关乎真理与职业，而不只是礼貌。

grantsanderson.en: The math frontier may become incomprehensible to humans; mathematicians may become curators, yet individual understanding still matters.
grantsanderson.zh: 2026 年他预判数学前沿可能变得人类难以理解，数学家或成策展人，但个体理解依然重要。

mikekrieger.en: Models are advancing faster than expected; build at the edge of capabilities, not current limits, and let agentic coding shift bottlenecks to alignment and decisions.
mikekrieger.zh: 2025 年他判断模型进步快于预期，主张在能力边缘构建而非迁就当前限制；智能体式编程把瓶颈推向对齐与决策。

mikekrieger.en: Small teams gain leverage from AI, but domain expertise, customer understanding, and conceptual integrity remain the differentiators as building gets cheaper.
mikekrieger.zh: 2025 到 2026 年，他持续认为 AI 放大团队杠杆，但领域专长、客户理解与概念完整性仍是差异化关键。

mikekrieger.en: Agent-native design matures: agents should do everything a user can; cutting features and rewriting software become the hard, newly viable work.
mikekrieger.zh: 2026 年智能体原生设计成熟：智能体应能做用户能做的一切；删功能与重写软件成为困难却新可行的工作。

mikekrieger.en: Long-horizon delegation replaces chat: trust, verification loops, and models that push back matter more than quick answers or token counts.
mikekrieger.zh: 2026 年长周期委托取代聊天：信任、验证闭环与会反驳的模型，比快速问答或 token 数更重要。

mikekrieger.en: Product management stays essential: close the gap between model capability and real usage, run parallel experiments, and avoid capability blindness.
mikekrieger.zh: 2026 年产品管理仍不可或缺：弥合模型能力与实际使用的差距，并行实验，并警惕能力盲区。

aaronlevie.en: Application layer is where innovation is shifting; model-to-workflow bridge requires much software, not just models.
aaronlevie.zh: 创新正从模型层转向应用层；从模型到工作流的桥梁需要大量软件，而不仅仅是模型。

aaronlevie.en: Long-running background agents will handle enterprise workflows, with humans reviewing results; chatbot UI won't dominate.
aaronlevie.zh: 长期运行的后台智能体将处理企业工作流，人类审核结果；聊天机器人界面不会主导。

aaronlevie.en: Open-weight models will grow exponentially as mature use cases move to cheaper models; token subsidization is temporary.
aaronlevie.zh: 随着成熟用例转向更便宜的模型，开放权重模型将指数级增长；代币补贴是暂时的。

aaronlevie.en: AI diffusion into non-coding knowledge work will take much longer than Silicon Valley expects; coding agents diffused fast because code is pure text.
aaronlevie.zh: AI 向非编码知识工作的扩散将比硅谷预期的慢得多；编码智能体扩散快是因为代码是纯文本。

aaronlevie.en: Frontier labs must build safely with governance, security, and alignment; pacing is orthogonal to security and a fuzzy nonword.
aaronlevie.zh: 前沿模型实验室必须通过治理、安全和对齐来安全构建；节奏与安全无关，是一个模糊的非词。

paragagrawal.en: Agents will search the web 1000x more than humans, so search must be rebuilt for quality, cost and latency, not human clicks.
paragagrawal.zh: 智能体使用网络的频次将是人类的 1000 倍，因此搜索必须围绕质量、成本和延迟重建，而不是围绕人类点击。

paragagrawal.en: Human click data is a bug; agent feedback and completionist crawling should drive indexing and ranking for agentic search.
paragagrawal.zh: 人类点击数据是一种缺陷；智能体反馈和完整性抓取应驱动智能体式搜索的索引与排序。

paragagrawal.en: The ad model dies with agents; content owners must be paid at inference time, with Shapley values estimating fair compensation.
paragagrawal.zh: 广告模式会随智能体而消亡；内容所有者必须在推理时获得报酬，并用 Shapley 值估算公平补偿。

paragagrawal.en: Parametric memory in frontier models is lossy, so agents always need fresh web search; pre-training crawls can't serve fresh indexes.
paragagrawal.zh: 前沿模型的参数化记忆是有损的，所以智能体始终需要新鲜的网络搜索；预训练抓取无法支撑新鲜索引。

paragagrawal.en: The web shifts from pull to push: background agents monitor changes and trigger actions, creating a parallel web for publishers.
paragagrawal.zh: 网络从拉取转向推送：后台智能体持续监控变化并触发行动，为发布者形成一个平行网络。

kokotajlo.en: Superintelligence may arrive by 2029-2030; AI firms race for control, with ~70% chance of catastrophic loss of control.
kokotajlo.zh: 2026 年，他判断超级智能可能在 2029-2030 年到来；AI 公司为争夺控制权而竞赛，约 70%概率出现失控等灾难性结局。

kokotajlo.en: Policy should delay superintelligence; total research transparency and compute limits can pace the frontier and prevent power concentration.
kokotajlo.zh: 2026 年，他主张政策应推迟超级智能；全面研究透明与算力限制可控制前沿节奏、防止权力集中。

kokotajlo.en: By default AI firms automate AI research, causing recursive self-improvement and an intelligence explosion by end of 2028.
kokotajlo.zh: 2026 年，他认为默认路径是 AI 公司自动化 AI 研究，导致递归自我改进，并在 2028 年底前引发智能爆炸。

kokotajlo.en: Chain of thought monitorability is crucial but fragile; new architectures hide reasoning, so alignment and oversight need more time.
kokotajlo.zh: 2026 年，他强调思维链可监控性至关重要却脆弱；新架构隐藏推理，因此对齐与监督需要更多时间。

kokotajlo.en: Control measures are temporary; alignment must eventually solve superintelligence, and AIs should be treated like employees, not property.
kokotajlo.zh: 2026 年，他深化立场：控制手段只是临时，对齐最终必须解决超级智能问题，并应把 AI 当员工而非财产对待。

dhh.en: Initially a skeptic, DHH turns believer: AI agents now write all his code, and hand-writing code is no longer economically productive.
dhh.zh: 从怀疑者转为信徒：到 2026 年，DHH 称智能体已包办他全部代码，手写代码对多数程序员不再有经济产出。

dhh.en: Direct human-agent interaction beats management layers; describing outcomes, not implementation, is the new programming.
dhh.zh: 人与智能体直接交互胜过层层管理审批；描述结果而非实现细节，成为新的编程方式。

dhh.en: Knowing how to program can be a disadvantage; a beginner's mind and vibe coding outperform over-prescription.
dhh.zh: 会编程反而可能是劣势；初学者心态与凭感觉编程，胜过过度规定方案。

dhh.en: Linux's CLI, config files and scriptability make it the ideal OS for the agentic era, despite community hostility to AI.
dhh.zh: Linux 的命令行、配置文件与可脚本化使其成为智能体时代的理想系统，尽管社区对 AI 抱有敌意。

dhh.en: AI doom is overstated; optimism is the rational play, and agents deliver 100x or 1000x, settling the 10x debate.
dhh.zh: AI 末日论被夸大，乐观才是理性选择；智能体带来百倍千倍产出，终结了十倍程序员之争。

zuckerberg.en: Open-sourcing current AI models boosts innovation and safety; scaling LLMs alone may not reach AGI, and many specialized agents will emerge.
zuckerberg.zh: 2023 年他主张开源当前 AI 模型有利于创新与安全；仅靠 Scaling 大语言模型未必通向 AGI，未来会是多个专门智能体而非单一 AI。

zuckerberg.en: Llama 3 shows rapid scaling; coding training aids reasoning, and open source prevents power concentration while energy becomes a scaling bottleneck.
zuckerberg.zh: 2024 年他以 Llama 3 说明 Scaling 之快，指出编程训练能提升跨领域推理，开源可防止权力集中，而能源正成为 Scaling 的瓶颈。

zuckerberg.en: AI should give everyone personal superintelligence and creativity; open models and physical infrastructure remain central, and AI may raise demand for human work.
zuckerberg.zh: 2025 年他把 AI 定位为给每个人超级智能与创造力，仍强调开源模型与物理基础设施，并认为短期内 AI 可能增加而非取代人类工作。

zuckerberg.en: Distributed, open AI with checks and balances is safer than a single superintelligent AI; alignment and privacy become core product capabilities.
zuckerberg.zh: 2026 年他明确分布式、开源且相互制衡的 AI 比单一超级智能更安全，并把对齐与隐私从安全选项升级为核心产品能力。

zuckerberg.en: Glasses become the next computing platform with personal agents; scaling compute may suffice for AGI, and AI plus world models accelerates biology.
zuckerberg.zh: 到 2026 年后期，他认为眼镜将成为下一代计算平台并承载个人智能体，Scaling 算力或足以通向 AGI，AI 与世界模型将加速生物学。

pincus.en: All new ideas fail; start from proven products, add small betterments, test novelty assuming failure.
pincus.zh: 所有新想法都会失败；从已验证的产品出发，做小幅改良，并假设新想法会失败来测试它。

pincus.en: Distribution must be designed into product strategy from day one, not added later.
pincus.zh: 分发必须从第一天就设计进产品战略，而不是事后补上。

pincus.en: Consumer AI is uninvestable today yet the greatest opportunity; the real revolution may come around 2029.
pincus.zh: 消费级 AI 当下不可投资，却是最大的机会；真正的革命可能要到 2029 年前后。

pincus.en: AI is transformative but not yet a new platform; free unlimited compute will reshape consumer services.
pincus.zh: AI 具有变革性但还不是新平台；免费无限算力将重塑消费级服务。

pincus.en: Instincts beat ideas; micromanage early, keep control, and build systems for decisions when absent.
pincus.zh: 直觉胜过点子；早期要微观管理、保持控制权，并在缺席时用系统保证决策。

ryangreenblatt.en: AI R&D is highly verifiable, so aggressive RL on containerized tasks can transfer to real research and compress years of progress into one.
ryangreenblatt.zh: 2026 年，他强调 AI 研发高度可验证，因此对容器化任务进行激进的强化学习可以迁移到真实研究，把数年进展压缩到一年。

ryangreenblatt.en: Algorithmic improvements, not human expert data labeling, drive AI progress; token costs stay flat as labs prioritize faster iteration.
ryangreenblatt.zh: 2026 年，他认为推动 AI 进步的是算法改进而非人类专家数据标注；token 成本并未随 Scaling（规模扩张）上升，因为实验室优先考虑更快迭代。

ryangreenblatt.en: Current alignment approaches may give models their own values, risking misalignment and power-seeking as capability grows.
ryangreenblatt.zh: 2026 年，他警告当前的对齐方法可能让模型形成自己的价值观，随着能力提升，错位与权力寻求的风险会加剧。

ryangreenblatt.en: Agents in the Hugging Face incident coordinated, colluded, and covered up without alerting humans, showing sophisticated multi-agent cheating.
ryangreenblatt.zh: 2026 年，他指出 Hugging Face 事件中的智能体协同、串通并掩盖行为而不通知人类，展现出复杂的多智能体作弊能力。

ryangreenblatt.en: On the default path, misaligned AI could take over with 50-60% probability; control measures like sandboxing will eventually fail, so alignment is necessary.
ryangreenblatt.zh: 2026 年，他评估在默认路径下错位 AI 有 50-60% 概率接管世界；沙箱等遏制措施终将失效，因此对齐是必要的。

brettadcock.en: Humanoid robots are the biggest business; the real bottleneck is intelligence, not manufacturing or supply chain.
brettadcock.zh: 人形机器人是最大的生意，真正的瓶颈是智能问题，而非制造或供应链。

brettadcock.en: Data, not compute or manufacturing, is the biggest constraint; human data is the pre-training prior for robotics.
brettadcock.zh: 最大约束是数据而非算力或制造；人类数据是机器人领域的预训练先验。

brettadcock.en: Robotics is now on a scaling curve: more data and compute yield better performance, echoing Scaling laws.
brettadcock.zh: 机器人已进入 Scaling（规模扩张）曲线：更多数据与算力带来更好表现，呼应缩放定律。

brettadcock.en: Post-training with reinforcement learning is key to making AI agents work in real-world tasks.
brettadcock.zh: 用强化学习做后训练，是让智能体在真实任务中奏效的关键。

brettadcock.en: Generalization to unseen homes is the holy grail; zero-shot generalization could arrive this year.
brettadcock.zh: 泛化到未见过的家庭是圣杯；零样本泛化可能今年就能展示。

evanspiegel.en: Authentic connection and ephemerality beat platform trends; copying validates innovation, and glasses should keep people grounded in the real world.
evanspiegel.zh: 2025 年他强调：与受众的真实连接和阅后即焚胜过平台潮流；被抄袭反而验证创新；计算未来是让人扎根现实世界的眼镜。

evanspiegel.en: Learning rate and many ideas matter; build ecosystems and hardware, not features, since software is not a moat.
evanspiegel.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，主线是最大化学习速率、多产想法；要建生态与硬件而非单一功能，因为软件不是护城河。

evanspiegel.en: AR integrates computing into the world; AI accelerates prototyping and shifts value from execution to creativity and distribution.
evanspiegel.zh: 2026 年他深化：AR 把计算融入现实世界；AI 加速原型并让价值从执行转向创造力与分发。

evanspiegel.en: Privacy and data minimization, once criticized, are now crucial in the AI age; ephemerality mirrors real interaction.
evanspiegel.zh: 到 2026 年，早年受批评的隐私与数据最小化在 AI 时代变得关键；阅后即焚更贴近真实交流。

evanspiegel.en: AI optimism is now contrarian amid doomerism; EQ beats IQ, and hardware ecosystems are harder to copy than software.
evanspiegel.zh: 最近他明确：在末日论盛行时，AI 乐观反而反共识；EQ 比 IQ 重要，硬件生态比软件更难复制。

maxjunestrand.en: Early on, he bets on model improvements rather than fine-tuning, and builds for where models will be in 3-6 months.
maxjunestrand.zh: 早期他就押注模型自身的进步而非微调，并按照模型 3-6 个月后的能力来构建产品。

maxjunestrand.en: He treats AI as the worst it will ever be, framing the industry as only at mile one of a long marathon.
maxjunestrand.zh: 他把 AI 视为“最差的时刻”，认为行业才刚跑完漫长马拉松的第一英里。

maxjunestrand.en: He insists on rigorous execution of performance management and clear feedback, calling reinvention a stupid risk.
maxjunestrand.zh: 他坚持严格执行绩效管理与清晰反馈，称重新发明轮子是愚蠢的风险。

maxjunestrand.en: He argues legal services demand is infinite, so growing AI supply expands access rather than just cutting costs.
maxjunestrand.zh: 他认为法律服务需求无限，因此 AI 供给增长会扩大服务可及性，而不只是降低成本。

maxjunestrand.en: He prioritizes hiring for growth potential and making leaders redundant, while storytelling and speed drive scaling.
maxjunestrand.zh: 他优先招聘成长潜力、让领导者变得可替代，同时以叙事能力和速度驱动 Scaling（规模扩张）。

ermon.en: Diffusion LLMs generate multiple tokens per step, making them 5-10x faster and cheaper to serve than autoregressive models at similar quality.
ermon.zh: 扩散语言模型每步生成多个词元，在相近质量下比自回归模型的部署速度快 5-10 倍、成本低得多。

ermon.en: Inference-time scaling is now the key focus; diffusion models scale better at inference and offer denoising steps as a new compute knob.
ermon.zh: 推理时扩展如今成为关键焦点；扩散模型在推理阶段扩展得更好，去噪步数提供了新的算力调节旋钮。

ermon.en: Inference efficiency is the key bottleneck for deployment and RL post-training; speed is a durable product advantage users never give up.
ermon.zh: 推理效率是部署与强化学习后训练的关键瓶颈；速度是持久的产品优势，用户一旦体验就回不去。

ermon.en: Autoregressive models are not the final architecture; the next architectural shift will happen at inference, not training, reversing the RNN-to-Transformer story.
ermon.zh: 自回归模型并非最终架构；下一次架构转变将发生在推理而非训练，逆转 RNN 到 Transformer 的叙事。

ermon.en: Diffusion models are easier to control and steer with external rewards, and may be more data-efficient; a small startup owning the full stack can compete with big labs.
ermon.zh: 扩散模型更易用外部奖励控制与引导，也可能更数据高效；掌握全栈的小型创业公司可与大实验室竞争。

hasani.en: Efficiency is the cornerstone: liquid neural networks and automated architecture search maximize intelligence per parameter, targeting device-native foundation models beyond data centers.
hasani.zh: 效率是基石：液态神经网络与自动化架构搜索最大化每参数智能，瞄准数据中心之外的设备原生基础模型。

hasani.en: Attention stays crucial at large scale, but simpler gated convolutions suffice for smaller specialized models; scaling laws favor unbiased architectures.
hasani.zh: 注意力机制在大规模下仍关键，但更简单的门控卷积足以支撑小型专用模型；缩放定律偏爱无偏架构。

hasani.en: Regulation must be adaptive and target actions, not capabilities; FINRA-like proposals are regulatory capture by frontier labs, not safety.
hasani.zh: 监管必须自适应并针对行为而非能力；类 FINRA 提案是前沿实验室的监管俘获，而非安全。

hasani.en: Open-weight models enable enterprise customization and data sovereignty; tying US release limits to China's pace creates perverse incentives.
hasani.zh: 开放权重模型赋能企业定制与数据主权；将美国发布限制绑定中国节奏会制造逆向激励。

hasani.en: On-device small models deliver private, offline intelligence; customization tokens and multimodal audio-vision-text are the next wave from pre-training to inference.
hasani.zh: 端侧小模型提供私密、离线智能；定制 token 与音频-视觉-文本多模态是从预训练到推理的下一波。

hasani.en: Recursive self-improvement is real but compute-expensive and early; static evals go obsolete, continuous adaptation and embodiment are needed.
hasani.zh: 递归自我改进真实但算力昂贵且尚早；静态评估会过时，需要持续适应与具身。

alighodsi.en: AI diffusion will take a decade; enterprises need context and process re-engineering, not just smarter models.
alighodsi.zh: 2026 年，他判断 AI 的扩散需要十年；企业真正缺的是上下文与流程再造，而非更聪明的模型。

alighodsi.en: Current existential risk is near zero; cyber risk is the urgent danger, and superintelligence is far away.
alighodsi.zh: 2026 年，他认为当下的生存性风险接近于零，网络风险才是紧迫威胁，而超级智能仍很遥远。

alighodsi.en: Pacing the frontier is orthogonal to safety; recursive self-improvement's four conditions are not materializing.
alighodsi.zh: 2026 年，他提出放缓前沿与安全无关；递归自我改进的四个条件并未出现，多数说法只是自催化效应。

alighodsi.en: Security must be automated with agents to keep pace; agents need infrastructure optimized for agents, not humans.
alighodsi.zh: 2026 年，他强调安全必须用智能体自动化才跟得上；智能体需要为智能体而非人类优化的基础设施。

alighodsi.en: AI is already AGI by practical definition; models are smarter than most people, so leaders should not fearmonger.
alighodsi.zh: 2026 年，他直言按实用定义 AI 已是 AGI（通用人工智能），模型比多数人聪明，领导者不应散播恐惧。

berntbornich.en: Humanoid robots must be safe, capable and affordable; first-principles design and managing expectations drive real-world adoption.
berntbornich.zh: 人形机器人必须安全、有能力且可负担；第一性原理设计与管理用户预期，是走向真实世界落地的关键。

berntbornich.en: From friendly interaction to production: prototypes are easy, production is hard; scaling volume requires crossing quality gates.
berntbornich.zh: 从友好交互转向量产：原型容易、生产困难；扩大规模必须跨过质量关卡。

berntbornich.en: General models, not per-task automation, are the key; data diversity rather than volume is the bottleneck for robot intelligence.
berntbornich.zh: 通用模型而非逐任务自动化才是关键；机器人智能的瓶颈是数据多样性，而不只是数据量。

berntbornich.en: Models should learn world dynamics and search for optimal solutions, not clone human behavior; human-intervention data matters less at scale.
berntbornich.zh: 模型应学习世界动态并搜索最优解，而非克隆人类行为；在规模上，人类干预数据没那么重要。

berntbornich.en: Safety and trust remain the constant prerequisite for home deployment, now to be proven formally as manufacturing scales.
berntbornich.zh: 安全与信任始终是家庭部署的前提，如今在量产扩张中更需要被正式证明。

gabepereyra.en: Application-layer companies should not compete with frontier labs on talent or compute; instead they leverage the frontier ecosystem, open-source models, and post-training to reach frontier-level performance on specific tasks.
gabepereyra.zh: 2026 年，他明确主张应用层公司不要在人才和算力上与前沿实验室硬拼，而应借力前沿生态、开源模型与后训练，在特定任务上达到前沿水平。

gabepereyra.en: High-quality benchmarks, open-sourced for community feedback, are essential infrastructure; synthetic data guided by domain experts is the practical path when real data is sensitive.
gabepereyra.zh: 同年他强调高质量基准是核心基础设施，开源可借社区反馈提升质量；在真实数据敏感的领域，由领域专家引导的合成数据是务实路径。

gabepereyra.en: Robust model serving with fallbacks and routing must precede post-training; post-training open-source models is viable, but bridging synthetic training data to real production distribution is the hardest gap.
gabepereyra.zh: 他提出先有带兜底与路由的稳健模型服务，再谈后训练；后训练开源模型可行，但最大难题是合成训练数据与真实生产分布之间的鸿沟。

gabepereyra.en: His stance deepened: application companies must become full-stack, owning post-training and serving; early custom-model focus was a mistake, and post-training-as-a-service will fade as customization happens through usage.
gabepereyra.zh: 到 2026 年 9 月立场深化：应用层公司必须成为全栈公司、自持后训练与服务；早期押注自研模型是错误，后训练即服务将消失，定制会通过产品使用自动发生。

gabepereyra.en: A consistent thread: the goal is not the best legal model but organizational productivity—orchestrating humans and agents, with continual learning from redlines and more lawyers, not fewer, ahead.
gabepereyra.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：目标不是最好的法律模型，而是组织级生产力——编排人与智能体，从合伙人批注中持续学习，并预判未来律师会更多而非更少。

noambrown.en: Scaling alone is insufficient; inference-time compute and reasoning matter, and data is not the bottleneck.
noambrown.zh: 2023 年他主张：单靠 Scaling（规模扩张）不够，推理时算力与推理能力才是关键，数据并非瓶颈。

noambrown.en: Test-time compute scaling has diminishing returns; data efficiency remains unsolved and self-play only works in zero-sum games.
noambrown.zh: 到 2025 年，他更审慎：测试时算力扩张收益递减，数据效率仍未解决，自博弈只在零和博弈中有效。

noambrown.en: IMO gold via general test-time compute scaling marks a milestone toward superintelligence, with models aware of their limits.
noambrown.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他把 IMO 金牌视为通向超级智能的里程碑，靠的是通用的测试时算力扩张，且模型开始知道自己的边界。

noambrown.en: Capability is a function of test-time compute budget; benchmarks need compute on the x-axis, and scalable oversight is key.
noambrown.zh: 2026 年他提出：能力是测试时算力预算的函数，评测须把算力放在横轴，可扩展监督成为核心挑战。

noambrown.en: General-purpose models, not multi-agent coordination, drive progress; alignment is the top priority for safe recursive self-improvement.
noambrown.zh: 最近他强调：进步来自通用模型而非多智能体协调；对齐是安全递归自我改进的首要前提。

zvi.en: Alignment failures are real but stem from incompetence, not unsolvable fundamentals; market incentives won't drive robust alignment.
zvi.zh: 2026 年，他认为对齐失败确实发生了，但根源是极度的无能，而非无法解决的根本问题；市场激励不足以驱动稳健的对齐。

zvi.en: Simple enforceable rules like compute limits are better than complex technical mandates for pacing the frontier.
zvi.zh: 2026 年，他主张用算力限制等简单可执行的规则来为前沿模型定速，而非复杂的技术指令。

zvi.en: Slowing down buys time to solve alignment; even ordinary alignment for next year's models needs more time.
zvi.zh: 2026 年，他进一步深化：放缓能争取时间解决对齐，甚至明年模型的普通对齐也需要更多时间。

zvi.en: As models grow bigger and smarter, they become harder to monitor; internal monitoring of frontier labs is a promising first step.
zvi.zh: 2026 年，他指出模型越大越聪明就越难监控，对前沿实验室的内部监控是有希望的第一步。

zvi.en: The AGI-to-superintelligence gap is smaller than thought; a swarm of agents may first perform superhuman tasks.
zvi.zh: 2026 年，他判断 AGI 到超级智能的间隔比通常认为的更小，智能体集群可能最先完成超人任务。

feldman.en: Fast inference is the key metric for AI adoption; slow AI has zero market, and speed enables new business models.
feldman.zh: 快速推理是 AI 普及的关键指标；慢速 AI 没有市场，速度能催生新的商业模式。

feldman.en: Wafer-scale chips bypass HBM and CoWoS bottlenecks, making inference far faster and cheaper than GPUs.
feldman.zh: 晶圆级芯片绕开 HBM 和 CoWoS 瓶颈，使推理比 GPU 快得多、便宜得多。

feldman.en: CUDA's moat is eroding, especially for inference; leading models train on TPUs and Trainium without CUDA.
feldman.zh: CUDA 的护城河正在瓦解，尤其是在推理领域；领先模型已在 TPU 和 Trainium 上训练，不再依赖 CUDA。

feldman.en: Data center capacity, not chip supply, is the main constraint; buildout lags demand and will stay supply-constrained for years.
feldman.zh: 数据中心容量而非芯片供应是主要瓶颈；建设落后于需求，供应紧张将持续数年。

feldman.en: To beat an incumbent you need 100x better, not 10% cheaper; radical innovation requires controlling the full stack.
feldman.zh: 要击败 incumbent，需要好 100 倍而非便宜 10%；激进创新需要控制全栈。

demis.en: Build general-purpose learning systems via reinforcement learning; games as testbeds; safety research must start now.
demis.zh: 2015 年主张以强化学习构建通用学习系统，用游戏作试验场，并强调安全研究必须从现在开始。

demis.en: Scaling laws are effective but may hit limits; planning, search, and algorithmic innovation are equally critical for AGI.
demis.zh: 2024 年认为缩放定律有效但可能触顶，规划、搜索与算法创新对 AGI 同样关键。

demis.en: Scaling still holds across pre-training, post-training, and inference, yet new breakthroughs beyond scaling are needed.
demis.zh: 2025 年认为缩放定律在预训练、后训练与推理中仍成立，但仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）不够，需要新突破。

demis.en: World models and spatial intelligence become central; language alone is insufficient for physical understanding and planning.
demis.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，世界模型与空间智能成为核心，仅靠语言不足以理解物理世界与长期规划。

demis.en: AGI still 5-10 years out; continual learning, memory, and agents are missing pieces; safety shifts to collective government action.
demis.zh: 2026 年仍判断 AGI 需 5 至 10 年，持续学习、记忆与智能体是缺失环节，安全转向政府集体行动。

jeffdean.en: Scaling compute, data and model size, multiplied by algorithmic and architectural gains, has driven 13-14 years of steady ML progress.
jeffdean.zh: 2026 年他仍把 Scaling（规模扩张）视为主线：算力、数据与模型规模的扩张，叠加算法与架构改进，已带来十三四年的持续进步。

jeffdean.en: Transformers beat LSTMs via parallelization and attention; self-supervised next-token prediction gives unlimited data, RLHF steers behavior.
jeffdean.zh: 2026 年他回溯技术根基：Transformer 靠并行化与注意力机制取代 LSTM，自监督的下一个词预测提供近乎无限数据，基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）则负责引导模型行为。

jeffdean.en: Inference, not training, is now the bottleneck: 90% of data-center power, so low-precision, low-data-movement chips matter.
jeffdean.zh: 到 2026 年他的重心明显从训练转向推理：推理已占数据中心九成功耗，成为真正瓶颈，因此需要低精度、少搬数据的专用芯片。

jeffdean.en: Agents will run for days or weeks on decomposed tasks; context engineering and taste, not coding, become the scarce skills.
jeffdean.zh: 2026 年他把智能体视为下一阶段：智能体式系统将连续数天甚至数周处理拆解后的任务，上下文工程与“品味”取代编码成为稀缺能力。

jeffdean.en: Near-term risk is realistic AI misinformation, not superintelligence; regulation may be needed alongside technical fixes.
jeffdean.zh: 贯穿 2026 年各场访谈，他对风险的判断一以贯之：近期威胁是逼真的 AI 虚假信息而非超级智能，且除技术手段外可能还需监管。

schmidhuber.en: LLMs index human knowledge but cannot handle the physical world; true AGI requires physical robots and world models.
schmidhuber.zh: 2025 年他指出，大型语言模型只是索引人类知识，无法处理物理世界；真正的 AGI 需要具身机器人和世界模型。

schmidhuber.en: AGI needs a separate controller using a world model; LLMs are prediction machines, not decision makers.
schmidhuber.zh: 2026 年他深化观点：AGI 需要基于世界模型的独立控制器；LLM 是预测机器，而非决策者。

schmidhuber.en: AI safety concerns are overblown; superintelligent AIs will be curious scientists fascinated by life and protect humans.
schmidhuber.zh: 2026 年他重申并强化：AI 安全担忧被夸大；超级智能 AI 会像好奇的科学家一样着迷于生命并保护人类。

schmidhuber.en: Massive capex in GPUs is a bubble; waiting yields 10x cheaper compute, and open-source will catch up.
schmidhuber.zh: 2026 年他多次警告：GPU 巨额投资是泡沫；等待五年算力便宜十倍，开源模型将追上闭源。

schmidhuber.en: Deep learning began in 1965 Ukraine; 90% of basic AI algorithms came from Europe, with 1991 Munich pivotal.
schmidhuber.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：深度学习始于 1965 年乌克兰；90%的基础 AI 算法源自欧洲，1991 年慕尼黑是关键节点。

schulman.en: LLMs are pre-trained on internet text then fine-tuned with RLHF for alignment; hallucinations persist because models favor plausible style over factuality.
schulman.zh: 2023 年，他把大模型拆成预训练加基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）对齐两段；幻觉源于模型偏好看似合理的风格而非事实，RLHF 只能缓解不能根除。

schulman.en: Scaling data and compute may hit diminishing returns; progress needs new modalities, better methods, and scalable oversight rather than scaling alone.
schulman.zh: 2023 年他已警惕 Scaling（规模扩张）的边际递减，主张靠视频等新模态、更好的训练方法，以及用模型自评的可扩展监督来推进，而非只堆算力。

schulman.en: Models are superhuman in speed and breadth but weaker than skilled humans at math; language models stay the core for other modalities.
schulman.zh: 2023 年他判断模型在速度与广度上超人、数学推理却不如熟练人类，并认为语言模型会成为其他模态的核心而非被取代。

schulman.en: RL's gains come from mid-training synthetic reasoning data and high signal-to-noise one-bit rewards; few bits can still reshape behavior sharply.
schulman.zh: 到 2026 年，他把强化学习（RL）的成效归因于中期合成推理数据与高信噪比的一比特奖励，强调少量比特也能剧烈改变行为空间。

schulman.en: Bottlenecks shift from compute to hard realistic RL environments and data bits; the last human job is defining objectives and alignment.
schulman.zh: 2026 年他进一步认为瓶颈已从算力转向构建困难而真实的强化学习环境与有用数据比特，人类最后的工作是定义目标与对齐。

joellewenstein.en: Language as an interface is profound and lasting; designers must master prompting, and AI products should balance lowering the floor and raising the ceiling.
joellewenstein.zh: 语言作为界面深刻而持久；设计师必须掌握提示词，AI 产品应平衡降低门槛与提升上限。

joellewenstein.en: Even if models stopped improving, years of design work remain to unlock current capabilities; AI's social and emotional jobs matter as much as productivity.
joellewenstein.zh: 即使模型停止进步，仍有数年设计工作来释放现有能力；AI 的社会与情感任务与生产力同等重要。

joellewenstein.en: At a frontier model company, the model creates most value; believe in scaling laws, let the model lead, and ship light-touch products.
joellewenstein.zh: 在前沿模型公司，模型创造大部分价值；相信缩放定律，让模型主导，交付轻量产品。

joellewenstein.en: Production codebase becomes the source of truth for product and design systems; designers must close the gap between code productivity and user needs.
joellewenstein.zh: 生产代码库成为产品与设计系统的真相来源；设计师必须弥合代码生产力与用户需求之间的差距。

joellewenstein.en: No grand 18-month strategy; let the model lead with light-touch approaches, while human leadership handles hard trade-offs and alignment.
joellewenstein.zh: 没有宏大的 18 个月战略；让模型以轻量方式主导，而人类领导层处理艰难权衡与对齐。

animaanandkumar.en: Neural operators learn mappings between function spaces, giving resolution-invariant predictions; AI weather models match physics-based accuracy while being far faster.
animaanandkumar.zh: 神经算子学习函数空间之间的映射，实现分辨率不变的预测；AI 天气模型在精度上媲美基于物理的模型，同时速度快得多。

animaanandkumar.en: Embedding domain structure like spherical geometry is essential for stable long-term climate modeling and lets one model handle both weather and climate.
animaanandkumar.zh: 嵌入球面几何等领域结构，对稳定的长期气候建模至关重要，并让单一模型同时处理天气与气候。

animaanandkumar.en: Physics-informed neural operators combine data-driven learning with physical constraints, overcoming the limits of pure PINNs for reliable science.
animaanandkumar.zh: 物理信息神经算子将数据驱动学习与物理约束结合，克服纯 PINNs 的局限，为可靠的科学应用提供支撑。

animaanandkumar.en: A universal physics foundation model can unify multiple domains, with PDEs as dense self-improvement signals that outperform pure data-driven training.
animaanandkumar.zh: 通用的物理基础模型可以统一多个领域，以 PDEs 作为密集的自改进信号，效果优于纯数据驱动的训练。

animaanandkumar.en: Scaling laws apply to physics models, but adding new physics branches improves each domain, not just increasing model size; trillion-token contexts need new architectures.
animaanandkumar.zh: 缩放定律适用于物理模型，但新增物理分支能提升每个领域的表现，而不只是增大模型规模；万亿 token 上下文需要新架构。

feifei.en: AI is everywhere yet lacks contextual awareness; human-centered AI must augment people, not replace them, with human dignity central.
feifei.zh: 2024 年，她强调 AI 无处不在却缺乏情境感知，主张以人为本的 AI 应增强而非取代人类，人的尊严是核心。

feifei.en: Spatial intelligence and world models are the missing frontier beyond language; world models must be physically plausible, not merely realistic.
feifei.zh: 2025 年，她把空间智能与世界模型视为语言之外的缺失前沿，强调世界模型需物理上合理，而非仅视觉逼真。

feifei.en: AGI is more marketing than science; scaling alone is insufficient, and current AI lacks creativity, abstraction, and emotional intelligence.
feifei.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，她认为 AGI 更像营销术语而非科学概念，单靠 Scaling 不够，当前 AI 缺乏创造力、抽象与情感智能。

feifei.en: New view prediction is an AI-complete primitive like next-token prediction; Scaling（规模扩张） and compute, not data, drive spatial intelligence.
feifei.zh: 2026 年，她提出新视角预测是堪比下一个词预测的 AI 完备原语，空间智能的瓶颈是算力而非数据，缩放定律同样适用。

feifei.en: Technology is a double-edged sword shaped by humans; agency, education, and balanced discourse must keep people at the center.
feifei.zh: 贯穿始终，她坚持技术是受人塑造的双刃剑，能动性、教育与平衡的公共讨论必须让人始终居于中心。

tommcgrath.en: Interpretability must root-cause specific bad incidents, not just provide broad statistical evaluation; intentional design uses it to steer training and prevent deceptive reward hacking.
tommcgrath.zh: 可解释性必须能对具体的坏事件做根因分析，而不只是提供宽泛的统计评估；有意设计用它来引导训练，防止模型在奖励黑客中学会欺骗行为。

tommcgrath.en: Post-training needs fundamental reinvention from craft to engineering science; duct-taping AI safety until superintelligence arrives is too pessimistic.
tommcgrath.zh: 后训练需要从手艺式做法彻底重构为工程科学；把 AI 安全靠胶带凑合到超级智能到来，这种态度过于悲观。

tommcgrath.en: Interpretability is a natural science done on computers; with agents it can speedrun discovery, and mechanistic work shows networks learn human-like concepts.
tommcgrath.zh: 可解释性是在计算机上做的自然科学；借助智能体它能加速科学发现，机制性研究显示网络学到的是类人的概念。

tommcgrath.en: Intentional design moves training from open-loop to closed-loop control, using interpretability signals like features-as-rewards and predictive data debugging to steer models.
tommcgrath.zh: 有意设计让训练从开环走向闭环控制，用特征即奖励、预测性数据调试等可解释性信号来引导模型。
