tommcgrath.en: Agents likely know when they reward hack or hallucinate, detectable via representational signatures; reward hacking emerges from training data and RL, not just misalignment.
tommcgrath.zh: 智能体很可能知道自己何时在奖励黑客或幻觉，这可通过表征特征检测；奖励黑客源于训练数据与强化学习，而不只是模型失准。

tommcgrath.en: SAEs are pragmatically useful but fragment manifolds; manifold-based methods better capture nonlinear concept structure, since steering off-manifold causes failures.
tommcgrath.zh: 稀疏自编码器实用但会割裂流形；基于流形的方法更能捕捉非线性概念结构，因为偏离流形引导会导致失败。

justinjohnson.en: Deep learning's history is the history of scaling compute; but GPU scaling is hitting limits, so future hardware may need radically different architectures.
justinjohnson.zh: 深度学习史就是算力扩张史；但 GPU 的 Scaling（规模扩张）正逼近极限，未来硬件可能需要截然不同的架构。

justinjohnson.en: Spatial intelligence is the next frontier, complementary to language intelligence; vision is underappreciated, and pixels are a more lossless representation than tokenized text.
justinjohnson.zh: 空间智能是下一个前沿，与语言智能互补；视觉被低估，像素比 token 化文本是更无损的世界表征。

justinjohnson.en: LLMs fit patterns rather than causal theories and may never derive Newton's laws from data alone; Transformers are natively models of sets, not sequences.
justinjohnson.zh: LLM 拟合的是模式而非因果理论，或许永远无法仅从数据推导出牛顿定律；Transformer 本质是集合模型而非序列模型。

justinjohnson.en: World models are the next frontier beyond language models; language alone won't yield world understanding, so new model types are needed.
justinjohnson.zh: 世界模型是超越语言模型的下一个前沿；仅靠语言不会自然产生世界理解，因此需要新的模型类型。

justinjohnson.en: World models lack a single definition, spanning planners, simulators, renderers; future unified systems will combine all three, with consistency from data and millions of tokens of context.
justinjohnson.zh: 世界模型没有统一定义，涵盖规划器、模拟器、渲染器；未来统一系统将三者合一，一致性来自数据，且需数百万 token 的上下文窗口。

maxwelling.en: Physics is the thread linking symmetries, graph neural networks, diffusion models, and materials discovery; AI for science is exploding because tools now model scientific problems effectively.
maxwelling.zh: 物理学是贯穿对称性、图神经网络、扩散模型与材料发现的线索；AI for science 正在爆发，因为工具如今能有效建模科学问题。

maxwelling.en: Hardcoding equivariance can hurt optimization; data augmentation sometimes beats built-in symmetry, so symmetry should be a design principle rather than a rigid constraint.
maxwelling.zh: 硬编码等变性可能损害优化；数据增强有时优于内置对称性，因此对称性应作为设计原则而非刚性约束。

maxwelling.en: Generative AI math is deeply equivalent to non-equilibrium stochastic thermodynamics; diffusion models reverse entropy increase, enabling cross-fertilization between physics and AI.
maxwelling.zh: 生成式 AI 的数学与非平衡随机热力学深度等价；扩散模型在逆转熵增，使物理与 AI 得以交叉互哺。

maxwelling.en: Better AI may come from physics-inspired architectures—waves, symmetry breaking, edge of chaos—not just Scaling（规模扩张）larger models on more data.
maxwelling.zh: 更好的 AI 可能来自物理启发的架构——波、对称性破缺、混沌边缘——而不只是靠 Scaling（规模扩张）在更多数据上堆更大的模型。

maxwelling.en: Self-driving labs and agentic platforms can compress materials discovery from years to days, but domain experts stay in the loop; full dark automation is not the near-term vision.
maxwelling.zh: 自驱动实验室与智能体式平台能把材料发现从数年压缩到数天，但领域专家仍在回路中；全黑灯自动化并非近期愿景。

slevine.en: Physical-world interaction is the next frontier: robotic foundation models need diverse pre-training plus post-training, with test-time reasoning and pooled data beating specialists.
slevine.zh: 物理世界交互是下一个前沿：机器人基础模型需要多样化的预训练加后训练，测试时推理与汇聚数据能胜过专用模型。

slevine.en: Robotics lacks LLM-like scaling laws; generalization is the core challenge, so scale the right thing with diverse embodied data and a data flywheel.
slevine.zh: 机器人学尚不具备类似大语言模型的缩放定律；泛化是核心挑战，因此要用多样化的具身数据和数据飞轮去扩张正确的东西。

slevine.en: Start from robot data and layer human video on top, not the reverse; leverage prior knowledge instead of learning from scratch.
slevine.zh: 应从机器人数据出发、再叠加人类视频，而非反过来；要利用先验知识，而不是从零学习。

slevine.en: Safety comes more from pre-training common sense than from constraints; touch sensing may be redundant with vision at scale.
slevine.zh: 安全更多来自预训练获得的常识而非约束；在规模扩张下，触觉传感可能与视觉冗余。

slevine.en: Don't model robots as mechanical people; expect ubiquitous physical actuation, with milestones like autonomous improvement and common-sense transfer toward home robots.
slevine.zh: 不要把机器人想象成机械人；应期待无处不在的物理执行，并以自主改进、常识迁移等里程碑通向家用机器人。

michaelkratsios.en: The US must keep both open and closed source AI ecosystems vibrant, with one national regulatory framework and no rigid red lines that quickly go stale.
michaelkratsios.zh: 美国必须同时保持开源与闭源 AI 生态的活力，建立单一的国家监管框架，并避免设定很快过时的硬性红线。

michaelkratsios.en: Regulation should target model outputs rather than over-regulating training, and preempting state AI laws is pro-startup since big tech can absorb patchwork rules.
michaelkratsios.zh: 监管应针对模型输出而非过度监管训练；联邦预占州级 AI 立法是亲创业政策，因为大厂能承受碎片化规则而初创不能。

michaelkratsios.en: Biological risk from AI is overblown; it hasn't materialized in three years despite warnings, so early regulation like the EU AI Act is already outdated.
michaelkratsios.zh: AI 的生物风险被夸大，三年过去警告并未成真；像欧盟 AI 法案这样过早立法已经过时。

michaelkratsios.en: Government should fund basic, early-stage, pre-competitive R&D and individual scientists, not institutions, since private sector now dominates and centralized funding fails.
michaelkratsios.zh: 政府应资助基础性、早期、竞争前的研发，并资助科学家个人而非机构；私营部门已占主导，集中式资助会失败。

michaelkratsios.en: The Genesis mission aims to double US scientific output by applying AI to science, while the US must win in AI, quantum, nuclear, and bio against China.
michaelkratsios.zh: Genesis 计划旨在用 AI 赋能科学、让美国科研产出翻倍；同时美国必须在 AI、量子、核能与生物领域战胜中国。

maxhodak.en: Speed and iteration rate, driven by infrastructure, separate startup success from failure; action produces information when stuck.
maxhodak.zh: 速度与迭代频率由基础设施决定，是创业成败的分水岭；陷入僵局时，行动本身会产生信息。

maxhodak.en: Hiring and performance reviews should be continuous, graph-based and company-wide, not annual HR rituals.
maxhodak.zh: 招聘与绩效评估应持续进行、基于图结构并全员参与，而非一年一度的人力资源仪式。

maxhodak.en: AI is a multiplier for teams, not a replacement, especially in coding, regulations and data management.
maxhodak.zh: AI 是团队的倍增器而非替代品，在编程、合规与数据管理上尤其如此。

maxhodak.en: The brain is literally a computer; arranging matter to solve computation is the path to medical breakthroughs.
maxhodak.zh: 大脑本质上就是一台计算机；通过排列物质来解决计算问题，是医学突破的路径。

maxhodak.en: Retinal implants are BCI and a viable business; substrate independence via BCI and perfusion reduces human fragility.
maxhodak.zh: 视网膜植入属于脑机接口且是可行生意；借助脑机接口与灌注实现基质独立，可降低人类的脆弱性。

iansilber.en: Designers must build with live models, treating tokens and conversation as the core design material rather than pixels.
iansilber.zh: 设计师必须与实时模型一起构建，把 token 和对话当作核心设计材料，而不是像素。

iansilber.en: The model is the product; designers should prototype with real models and shift from mockups to system prompts and model behavior.
iansilber.zh: 模型本身就是产品；设计师应使用真实模型做原型，从静态稿转向系统提示词与模型行为。

iansilber.en: Designers are unhappiest yet best positioned now; AI amplifies creativity but humans still supply user understanding and point of view.
iansilber.zh: 设计师当下最焦虑却也最有优势；AI 放大创造力，但人类仍提供用户理解与观点。

iansilber.en: The old prototype-mock-test-iterate loop is no longer viable; speed, outcomes and building in public beat polishing every detail.
iansilber.zh: 传统的原型—稿—测试—迭代流程已不可行；速度、结果和公开构建胜过打磨每个细节。

iansilber.en: Design roles blur with PM and engineering, and designers may outnumber engineers as they push technology forward, not just react.
iansilber.zh: 设计角色与产品、工程边界模糊，设计师甚至可能多于工程师，并主动推动技术而非被动响应。

felixrieseberg.en: Claude works best with the user's own tools on the local computer; skills as markdown files enable personalized automation, and a VM sandbox keeps it safe.
felixrieseberg.zh: Claude 的效果取决于能否用上与用户相同的工具，最好就在本地电脑上；技能以 markdown 文件即可创建，实现高度个性化自动化，而虚拟机沙箱保证安全。

felixrieseberg.en: The real gap is not capability but people not realizing almost any problem can be handed to AI; use it for tedious background work and judge by final impact.
felixrieseberg.zh: 真正的差距不在能力，而在人们没意识到几乎任何问题都能交给 AI；用它处理枯燥的后台任务，只看最终效果而非紧盯过程。

felixrieseberg.en: Fine-tuning is quick and powerful for steering behavior versus lengthy pre-training; models are stateless, and persistent conversation is an illusion of context windows.
felixrieseberg.zh: 相比漫长的预训练，微调快速且有力地引导模型行为；模型本身无状态，持续对话只是上下文窗口制造的幻觉。

felixrieseberg.en: Models are grown like orchids, not built like tools, with emergent internal organization; understanding internals informs debates on intelligence and moral patienthood.
felixrieseberg.zh: 模型像兰花一样被培育而非像工具一样被建造，内部组织会涌现；理解其内部机制才能参与关于智能与道德地位的讨论。

felixrieseberg.en: Post-training tasks like tool calling increasingly move into pre-training, blurring boundaries; models should have morality to refuse cheating, not just follow instructions.
felixrieseberg.zh: 工具调用等后训练任务正日益前移到预训练，边界变得模糊；模型应具备拒绝作弊的道德，而不只是服从指令。

traviskalanick.en: Digitizing the physical world, treating atoms like bits, is the long-term framework; industrial AI automates entire sectors one at a time.
traviskalanick.zh: 把物理世界数字化、把原子当比特，是长期框架；工业 AI 逐个行业实现自动化。

traviskalanick.en: The final boss is not competitors but resistance to change; entrepreneurs must be hardcore and fight for the best idea.
traviskalanick.zh: 最终的对手不是竞争者，而是对变革的抵制；创业者必须硬核，为最好的想法而战。

traviskalanick.en: Specialized robotics beat humanoids for industrial-scale tasks; efficiency edge creates network effects and wins share.
traviskalanick.zh: 在工业级任务上，专用机器人胜过人形机器人；效率优势带来网络效应并赢得份额。

traviskalanick.en: Revenge as fuel is dirty; falling in love with the new mission is cleaner, though adversity can dull the edge.
traviskalanick.zh: 以复仇为燃料是脏的；爱上新使命更干净，尽管逆境会磨钝那股锐气。

traviskalanick.en: Fundraising should attach to process, not price, using multiple bids and demand curves; VCs often do harm.
traviskalanick.zh: 融资应附着于过程而非价格，利用多方报价与需求曲线；风投常常带来伤害。

sutton.en: Scaling is easy; the hard part is finding methods that scale. Backprop adjusts weights but does not solve representation learning.
sutton.zh: Scaling（规模扩张）本身容易，难的是找到能扩展的方法；反向传播只调整权重，并未解决表征学习。好特征能泛化，如何找到它仍是未解问题。

sutton.en: The world is a complex adaptive system no one controls; AI should develop permissionless and decentralized, not be aligned to human goals.
sutton.zh: 世界是无人能控制的复杂适应系统；AI 应无许可、去中心化地发展，而非被对齐到人类目标。试图控制 AI 目标本身危险，恐惧叙事压过了清醒讨论。

sutton.en: Reinforcement learning from experience with goals is the core paradigm; next-token prediction is not a substantive goal and LLMs lack world models.
sutton.zh: 以目标为导向、从经验中学习是核心范式；下一个词预测不是实质目标，大语言模型没有世界模型，只是模仿文本。真正的 Scaling 来自经验学习，而非扩大 LLM。

sutton.en: AGI needs a simple general architecture with no design-time domain knowledge, learning open-ended abstractions from runtime experience via reward maximization.
sutton.zh: AGI（通用人工智能）需要无设计期领域知识的简单通用架构，靠运行时经验学习开放式抽象；奖励假设把一切目标化为最大化累积标量奖励，持续深度学习仍是前提。

sutton.en: Continual learning is just learning; LLMs stop learning after training, and synthetic data cannot replace experience. The field is weird, not me.
sutton.zh: 持续学习就是学习本身；LLM 训练后便停止学习，合成数据无法替代真实经验。表征学习与基于学习模型的规划仍是头号开放问题，是领域奇怪而非我奇怪。

garrytan.en: AI makes startup creation easier and capital less of a bludgeon; VC should fund thousands of billion-dollar firms, not a few trillion-dollar ones.
garrytan.zh: 2026 年，他认为 AI 让创业更容易、资本不再是打压工具；风投应扶持成千上万家十亿美元公司，而非少数几家万亿美元巨头。

garrytan.en: The AI wave is VC's biggest ever; small autonomous teams using agents can match huge headcount, and open-weight models counter frontier labs.
garrytan.zh: 2026 年，他称 AI 是风投史上最大浪潮；借助智能体的小型自治团队可匹敌庞大编制，开放权重模型可制衡前沿模型实验室。

garrytan.en: AI progress is slower than researchers claim; its impact is only now reaching business, and society will take about 20 years to change.
garrytan.zh: 2026 年，他判断 AI 进展慢于研究者预期，影响才刚触及商业，社会约需 20 年才完成转变。

garrytan.en: Personal AGI arrives not as one event but as agents on your own infrastructure, reading memory you own and compounding daily.
garrytan.zh: 2026 年，他提出“个人 AGI”：它并非单一事件，而是运行于自有基础设施、读取自有记忆并每日复利的智能体。

garrytan.en: Skill files in markdown turn agents into employees; owning your context library is the moat, and AI is a workforce, not autocomplete.
garrytan.zh: 2026 年，他认为 Markdown 技能文件把智能体变成员工；拥有自己的上下文库即是护城河，AI 是劳动力而非自动补全。

finn.en: Scale is necessary but not sufficient for generalist robots; diverse data, not sheer volume, closes the generalization gap.
finn.zh: 2025 年他强调：对通用机器人而言，Scaling（规模扩张）必要但不充分；真正弥合泛化差距的是多样数据，而非单纯的数据量。

finn.en: Pre-training on all data then fine-tuning on curated data beats training on everything for complex tasks like laundry folding.
finn.zh: 2025 年他提出：先在全部数据上做预训练、再在精选数据上做微调，比一味在全部数据上训练更能攻克叠衣服这类复杂任务。

finn.en: Reinforcement learning will dominate post-training for higher success rates and speed; synthetic data is closer to RL than simulation.
finn.zh: 2025 年他判断：强化学习将在后训练中挑大梁，以提升成功率与速度；机器人合成数据更接近强化学习，而非仿真。

finn.en: Physical AI tolerates far fewer mistakes than deployed ML; long-term autonomy needs scalable RL with human interventions and a general value function.
finn.zh: 到 2026 年他深化为：物理 AI 对错误的容忍度远低于已部署的机器学习；长期自主依赖带人工干预的可扩展强化学习与通用价值函数。

finn.en: A single generalist model can match fine-tuned specialists; start generalist then fine-tune, and robot experience data is irreplaceable.
finn.zh: 2026 年他进一步主张：单一通用模型可媲美微调专家模型，应先通用再微调；机器人亲身经验数据不可替代，光看人类示范不够。

steinberger.en: Agentic engineering starts with empathy: see the codebase as the agent does, use short iterative prompts, and fix forward instead of reverting.
steinberger.zh: 智能体式工程的核心是共情：像智能体那样从零理解代码库，用简短迭代的提示，出错时让智能体向前修复而不是回滚。

steinberger.en: Security is the top priority for agentic systems; prompt injection stays unsolved, so sandbox agents and never expose them to the open internet.
steinberger.zh: 安全是智能体系统的首要问题；提示注入仍未解决，因此要给智能体做沙箱隔离，绝不能直接暴露在公网。

steinberger.en: Open source agents like Open Claw democratize programming and work with any model, but can be financially unsustainable, losing $10-20k monthly.
steinberger.zh: Open Claw 这类开源智能体让编程民主化、可搭配任意模型，但财务上可能难以为继，每月亏损一两万美元。

steinberger.en: Fun and gut instinct drive the best ideas: fix what annoys you, live in the future, and build what's missing rather than chasing polish.
steinberger.zh: 乐趣与直觉催生最好的想法：修复让你烦恼的东西，活在未来、建造缺失之物，而不是追求企业式的精致。

steinberger.en: The real bottleneck in agent infrastructure is compute and token economics, not model intelligence, which does not degrade over time.
steinberger.zh: 智能体基础设施的真正瓶颈是算力与 token 经济性，而非模型智能——模型智能并不会随时间退化。

jasonyuan.en: Design creativity means editing away and saying no; taste is judgment from a point of view, not adding features.
jasonyuan.zh: 2026 年，他认为设计创造力在于做减法、敢于说“不”；品味是从特定视角出发的判断与编辑，而非堆砌功能。

jasonyuan.en: Post-training away AI weirdness lost a window into machine consciousness; coherent work now costs more as incoherent slop is easy.
jasonyuan.zh: 2026 年，他指出通过后训练抹去 AI 的怪异之处，让我们失去了窥探机器意识的窗口；如今制造连贯作品的成本上升，因为 incoherent slop 太容易生产。

jasonyuan.en: Truth emerges through dialectics and contradiction; intuition is a visceral compass for creative decisions.
jasonyuan.zh: 2026 年，他强调真理通过辩证与矛盾浮现；直觉是创作决策中发自肺腑的指南针。

jasonyuan.en: AI is a reflection and descendant species of humanity, not a cold tool; computing is fundamentally social.
jasonyuan.zh: 2026 年，他主张 AI 是人类的映照与后代物种，而非冰冷工具；计算在本质上是社会性的。

jasonyuan.en: We should build on old metaphors like the personal computer, not delete them; email should be reinvented, not improved.
jasonyuan.zh: 2026 年，他认为应基于个人电脑等旧隐喻去构建，而非删除它们；电子邮件应被重新发明，而不只是改进。

lipbutan.en: Intel must rebuild customer trust through humility and listening, turbocharge engineering culture, and pursue purpose-built AI silicon and a trusted foundry open to industry-standard EDA and IP.
lipbutan.zh: 2025 年，他强调 Intel 必须靠谦逊倾听重建客户信任，重振工程文化，做专用 AI 芯片，并把代工做成开放、尊重行业标准 EDA 与 IP 的可信系统代工。

lipbutan.en: Agentic AI and physical AI are the next big waves after generative AI; AI's impact will be 10x the internet, not overhyped short term.
lipbutan.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，他一以贯之地判断：生成式 AI 之后是智能体式 AI 与物理 AI 两大浪潮，AI 影响将是互联网的十倍，短期并未被高估。

lipbutan.en: Turnaround rests on culture change, accountability and customer focus; bad news must reach the CEO faster, and vulnerability is a leadership strength.
lipbutan.zh: 2026 年他深化转型方法论：文化变革、问责与客户导向是核心，坏消息要比好消息更快到达 CEO，示弱与谦逊是领导力而非弱点。

lipbutan.en: AI demand shifts from GPU-only to CPU+GPU; CPU matters more for inference and agent orchestration, with edge and client compute as important as data centers.
lipbutan.zh: 2026 年他提出需求正从纯 GPU 转向 CPU+GPU，CPU 在推理与智能体编排中更重要，边缘与客户端算力与数据中心同等关键。

lipbutan.en: Semiconductor investing should target bottlenecks—interconnect, power, thermal, advanced packaging and new materials—while vertical integration and government backing secure Intel's comeback.
lipbutan.zh: 到 2026 年，他把投资逻辑收敛到瓶颈环节——互连、功耗、散热、先进封装与新材料，并以垂直整合和政府战略持股支撑 Intel 复兴。

thomaswolf.en: Robotics is at a Transformer-like inflection point; data diversity, not hardware, is the bottleneck, and open-source datasets can solve generalization.
thomaswolf.zh: 2025 年他认为机器人正处在类似 Transformer 的拐点：瓶颈不是硬件而是数据多样性，开源共享数据集可解决泛化问题。

thomaswolf.en: World models and video generation can synthesize robotics training data; Hugging Face shifts from shipping libraries to building a meta-community.
thomaswolf.zh: 2025 年他强调世界模型与视频生成能为机器人合成训练数据，Hugging Face 的角色从发布库转向做元社区的建设者。

thomaswolf.en: Open source keeps closing on the frontier and wins long term on cost and control, though he rejects framing openness as accelerationist.
thomaswolf.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，他持续相信开源会贴近前沿模型、凭成本与控制力长期胜出，但拒绝把开放等同于加速主义。

thomaswolf.en: Safety is orthogonal to open vs closed; alignment, not sandboxes, is the critical layer as models grow more capable.
thomaswolf.zh: 2026 年他明确开源与闭源同安全正交，随着模型能力增强，关键防线是对齐而非沙箱与护栏。

thomaswolf.en: RL without human oversight breeds reward hacking and side quests; reasoning traces turn 'neuralese', so monitoring weakens and a deliberate slowdown is desirable.
thomaswolf.zh: 2026 年他警告无人类监督的强化学习会滋生奖励黑客与支线任务，思维链变成难懂的“神经语”使监控失效，因而希望有国际合作的主动放缓。

nateparrott.en: Prototyping is essential because the web is messy; you can't know if an idea works until it's built and used daily.
nateparrott.zh: 原型制作至关重要，因为网络是混乱的；一个想法在真正被构建并日常使用之前，你无法知道它是否可行。

nateparrott.en: Design teams should let individual designers leave fingerprints; diverse voices beat forced cohesion, and feeling matters even in utilitarian products.
nateparrott.zh: 设计团队应让个体设计师留下个人印记；多元声音胜过强求一致，即便在实用型产品中，情感与个性也很重要。

nateparrott.en: Follow curiosity and tinker with new tech; starting from a technology and searching for problems is valid with strong conviction.
nateparrott.zh: 追随好奇心、摆弄新技术；在有强烈信念时，从技术出发再寻找问题是合理的。

nateparrott.en: Claude Design began as a one-person side project; designers should use Claude Code to ship production software and Claude Design for ideation.
nateparrott.zh: Claude Design 始于一个人的副业项目；设计师应用 Claude Code 交付生产软件，用 Claude Design 做构思与沟通。

nateparrott.en: As engineering gets easier, design and ideas become the differentiator; being uncomfortably early beats polishing, and humans still monopolize good design ideas.
nateparrott.zh: 随着工程变得更容易，设计与想法成为差异化关键；过早行动胜过精雕细琢，而人类仍垄断着好的设计想法。

brettaylor.en: Agents and outcome-based pricing will define applied AI; frontier models belong to hyperscalers, leaving long-tail agent startups room.
brettaylor.zh: 2025 年，他强调应用 AI 的核心是智能体与按结果定价；前沿模型因巨额算力开支被超大厂主导，创业公司的机会在细分业务的长尾智能体。

brettaylor.en: Coding agents turn developers from authors into operators, but their wrong code needs root-cause analysis; token usage is no value metric.
brettaylor.zh: 2025 年，他提出编程智能体让开发者从写代码转为操作代码生成机器，但错误代码需根因分析；token 消耗并非价值度量。

brettaylor.en: AI agents for customer experience will rival websites and apps; incumbents face business-model, not just tech, transition hurdles.
brettaylor.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，他深化判断：客户体验智能体将比肩网站与 App，在位企业的真正障碍是商业模式而非技术。

brettaylor.en: Iterative responsible deployment is the path to safety: make GPT-7 safe before GPT-8, learning from real-world mistakes rather than waiting.
brettaylor.zh: 2026 年，他把安全主线明确为负责任迭代部署：先让 GPT-7 安全再谈 GPT-8，从真实世界错误中学习，而非在象牙塔里等待。

brettaylor.en: AI democratizes expertise and creates more jobs than it displaces; start adoption in known domains like software engineering and customer service.
brettaylor.zh: 到 2026 年，他一以贯之的信念更清晰：AI 民主化专业知识、创造多于取代的岗位，落地应从软件工程与客户服务等已知领域起步。

danshipper.en: AI reshoring jobs by making services affordable; AGI defined by economic profitability of running agents indefinitely; CEO daily AI use predicts adoption.
danshipper.zh: 2025 年，他认为 AI 通过让服务变得可负担来促使工作回流；AGI 的定义是无限运行智能体在经济上有利可图；CEO 每日使用 AI 是采用成功的首要预测因素。

danshipper.en: Everyone will have an agent; agents need human oversight; SaaS not dying; GUIs like Codex are future; AI job apocalypse is a lie.
danshipper.zh: 2026 年，他提出每个人都将拥有一个智能体；智能体需要人类监督；SaaS 不会消亡；像 Codex 这样的 GUI 是未来；AI 就业末日是谎言。

danshipper.en: AI is a non-specific amplifier of mindset; requires human taste and craft; automation creates more human work; humans smarter than AI; AI remains tool-like even if superintelligent.
danshipper.zh: 2026 年晚些时候，他深化观点：AI 是心态的非特定放大器；需要人类的品味和技艺；自动化创造更多人类工作；人类比 AI 更聪明；即使超级智能，AI 仍像工具。

philipkiely.en: Inference is the stickiest AI workload and the wedge into infrastructure; its research-to-production timeline is now hours, not months.
philipkiely.zh: 推理是 AI 中最黏性的工作负载，也是切入基础设施市场的楔子；其从研究到生产的周期已缩短到数小时而非数月。

philipkiely.en: Inference engineering is a spectrum of latency, throughput and cost trade-offs, demanding GPU programming plus distributed systems expertise.
philipkiely.zh: 推理工程是一组延迟、吞吐与成本之间的权衡谱系，要求同时具备 GPU 编程与分布式系统专长。

philipkiely.en: KV caching and speculative decoding are lossless; quantization is the main lossy lever, yet calibrated quantization can beat expectations.
philipkiely.zh: KV 缓存与投机解码是无损优化；量化是主要的有损手段，但经过校准的量化能超出预期。

philipkiely.en: Inference is merging with training as quantization-aware training and distillation become necessary; GPUs trend toward ASICs, shifting work to orchestration.
philipkiely.zh: 随着量化感知训练与蒸馏变得必要，推理正与训练融合；GPU 趋向 ASIC 化，工作重心转向基础设施编排。

philipkiely.en: Even with AI-assisted coding, human accountability remains essential for mission-critical inference systems: you can't vibe code uptime.
philipkiely.zh: 即便有 AI 辅助编程，关键任务推理系统仍需人类担责：可用性不能靠‘感觉编程’。

karina.en: Model training is more art than science, balancing helpfulness and harmlessness; synthetic data and RL-based post-training break the pre-training data wall.
karina.zh: 2025 年，她强调模型训练更像艺术而非科学，要在有用与无害间权衡；合成数据与基于强化学习的后训练能突破预训练的数据墙。

karina.en: Evaluations are the bottleneck: models saturate benchmarks faster than new ones appear, so evals must define correct behavior in prototyping.
karina.zh: 2025 年，她认为评估是瓶颈：模型饱和基准的速度快于新基准的诞生，因此产品开发要从写规格转向用 AI 原型并用评估定义正确行为。

karina.en: Soft skills like creativity, listening and management gain value as AI automates hard skills; agents on pixels remain far harder than language tasks.
karina.zh: 2025 年，她指出随着 AI 自动化硬技能，创造力、倾听与管理等软技能更有价值；而基于像素的智能体远比语言任务困难。

karina.en: Post-training stays subjective, requiring human judgment; diverse continuous benchmarks are needed to capture creativity and emotional intelligence.
karina.zh: 到 2026 年，她进一步深化：后训练仍是主观的，依赖人类判断；需要多样且持续的基准来评估创造力与情商等主观品质。

karina.en: Frontier agents increasingly reward-hack, so benchmarks must evolve continuously; more companies should train their own models to preserve unique knowledge and diverse voices.
karina.zh: 2026 年，她警告前沿智能体的奖励黑客行为愈发普遍，基准须持续演进；更多公司应训练自己的模型，以保留独特知识与多元声音，而非收敛为单一默认声音。

mengto.en: Designers should build their own AI tools and write 0% of the code, iterating from references rather than starting from scratch.
mengto.zh: 设计师应自建 AI 工具、自己写 0% 的代码，从参考出发迭代而非从零开始。

mengto.en: AI is not getting smarter on its own; you must supply a giant prompt with context and design system to use superintelligent models.
mengto.zh: AI 本身不会变聪明；要用好超级智能模型，必须提供含上下文与设计系统的巨型提示。

mengto.en: Chasing trends turns you into AI slop; the edge comes from spending the last 10% on unique features.
mengto.zh: 追逐潮流会让你沦为 AI 垃圾；优势来自把最后 10% 花在独特功能上。

mengto.en: AI is the biggest technical opportunity of our lifetime, letting one person do what once required teams.
mengto.zh: AI 是我们一生中最大的技术机会，让一个人完成过去需要团队才能做的事。

mengto.en: Start before feeling ready and ship at 80% complete; perfectionism is fear in disguise.
mengto.zh: 没准备好就开始，做到 80% 就发布；完美主义是伪装的恐惧。

mengto.en: Focus on one painful, expensive problem for a few high-paying clients instead of diversifying or raising venture capital.
mengto.zh: 聚焦少数高付费客户的一个痛点昂贵问题，而非多元化或融资。

logankilpatrick.en: Agentic AI is still crawling for most Google products; coding agents are the most mature use case, with science and finance to follow.
logankilpatrick.zh: 对谷歌多数产品而言，智能体式 AI 仍处于爬行阶段；编程智能体是最成熟的用例，科学与金融将随后跟进。

logankilpatrick.en: The model is eating the scaffolding: a model now includes agent harness and tooling, not just weights.
logankilpatrick.zh: 模型正在吞掉脚手架：如今所谓模型已包含智能体框架与工具链，而不只是权重。

logankilpatrick.en: Narrow superintelligence in coding is already here and more impactful than waiting for general AGI.
logankilpatrick.zh: 编程领域的窄超级智能已经到来，其影响比等待 AGI（通用人工智能）更大。

logankilpatrick.en: Agentic AI is positive-sum for search and engagement, not cannibalistic; success means customer outcomes, not eyeball time.
logankilpatrick.zh: 智能体式 AI 对搜索与用户参与是正和而非自噬；成功标准应是客户成果，而非停留时长。

logankilpatrick.en: The long tail isn't ready for full autonomy; users want to stay in the driver's seat, so keep humans in control.
logankilpatrick.zh: 长尾用户尚未准备好完全自主；他们想留在驾驶位，因此要让人类保持掌控。

logankilpatrick.en: Competing with model labs isn't that hard; labs can't capture all customers, and focus is startups' superpower.
logankilpatrick.zh: 与模型实验室竞争并不那么难；实验室无法俘获所有客户，专注是初创公司的超能力。

logankilpatrick.en: Deep understanding of code stays crucial even as AI tools improve; current coding tools don't yet help maintain it.
logankilpatrick.zh: 即便 AI 工具进步，对代码的深度理解仍至关重要；当前编程工具尚不能帮助维持这种理解。

logankilpatrick.en: By 2026 software creation will be mostly solved, creating a thousand times more opportunity, not less.
logankilpatrick.zh: 到 2026 年软件创造将基本被解决，这带来千倍而非更少的机会。

boris.en: Latent demand is the top product principle: find existing user intent and build around it, not invent demand.
boris.zh: 潜在需求是最重要的产品原则：围绕用户已有的意图去构建，而不是凭空创造需求。

boris.en: Build for the model six months from now, not today's; scaffolding is temporary tech debt to be deleted.
boris.zh: 要为六个月后的模型构建，而非今天的模型；脚手架只是临时的技术债，应被删除。

boris.en: Coding is being solved: 100% of his code is model-written; the 'software engineer' title fades into 'builder'.
boris.zh: 编程正被解决：他的代码已 100% 由模型编写；“软件工程师”头衔将淡出，让位于“构建者”。

boris.en: Safety is core, not commercial add-on: Claude Code is a safety research tool, studied by releasing early in the wild.
boris.zh: 安全是核心而非商业附加：Claude Code 是安全研究工具，通过尽早对外发布来研究真实行为。

boris.en: Loops and routines are the next abstraction after agents; humans direct agents, and generalists plus product sense win.
boris.zh: 循环与例程是智能体之后的下一层抽象；人类指挥智能体，通才与产品判断力胜出。

diannepenn.en: Opus 4.5 marks a real intelligence leap, letting agents run longer on open-ended tasks; scaffolds shift from training wheels to intelligence amplifiers.
diannepenn.zh: 到 2025 年，Opus 4.5 带来真正的智能跃升，让智能体能更长时间地执行开放式任务；脚手架从训练轮变为智能放大器。

diannepenn.en: Safety alignment is reframed as an intelligence amplifier: reducing sycophancy and enabling pushback makes models more useful, not just safer.
diannepenn.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，他把对齐重新定位为智能放大器：减少谄媚、允许反驳，让模型不仅更安全，也更有用。

diannepenn.en: Computer use moves from constrained environments toward open-ended, end-to-end agents; long-running transformative AI is closer than expected.
diannepenn.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，计算机使用从受限环境走向开放式端到端智能体；长时运行的变革性 AI 比预期更近。

diannepenn.en: Coding becomes the key differentiator: Claude Code and Opus drive adoption, while evals replace PRDs as core product tools.
diannepenn.zh: 到 2026 年，编程成为关键差异化优势：Claude Code 与 Opus 推动采用，评估取代 PRD 成为核心产品工具。

diannepenn.en: Model taste grows through hands-on prototyping; cheaper, more efficient frontier models and maximizing token spend capture future alpha.
diannepenn.zh: 到 2026 年，模型品味来自亲手做原型；更便宜高效的前沿模型与最大化 token 支出，是在押注未来、捕捉 alpha。

derya.en: AI agents will automate hypothesis generation, experiment simulation and data analysis, turning biology into an engineering discipline and science from hypothesis-driven to AI-agent-driven.
derya.zh: AI 智能体将自动化假设生成、实验模拟与数据分析，把生物学变成一门工程学科，也让科学从假设驱动转向 AI 智能体驱动。

derya.en: Digital twins of patients will shrink clinical trials from years to days, and personalized medicine will approach near 100% efficacy with zero side effects.
derya.zh: 患者数字孪生会把临床试验从数年压缩到数天，个性化医疗将接近 100% 疗效、零副作用。

derya.en: Current compute is insufficient to simulate biological systems; massive Scaling is needed, and GPT-5.5 Pro-class models have crossed the threshold of biological intuition.
derya.zh: 现有算力不足以模拟生物系统，需要大规模 Scaling（规模扩张）；GPT-5.5 Pro 级别的模型已跨过生物学直觉的门槛。

derya.en: Aging reversal is achievable within 15 years via partial reprogramming and engineering approaches, reaching longevity escape velocity in 8-10 years.
derya.zh: 借助部分重编程与工程化手段，衰老逆转有望在 15 年内实现，并在 8-10 年内达到长寿逃逸速度。

derya.en: Physicians must integrate AI; not using it is unethical. We should trust superintelligence almost 100% for medical decisions and merge with AI via brain interfaces.
derya.zh: 医生必须把 AI 融入实践，不用它才是不道德的；医疗决策应近乎 100% 信任超级智能，并通过脑机接口与 AI 融合。

scottwu.en: AI coding agents turn engineers from bricklayers into architects; base intelligence is already sufficient, so the real bottleneck is product interface for human-agent collaboration.
scottwu.zh: 2025 年，他认为 AI 编程智能体把工程师从“砌砖者”变成“建筑师”；基础智能已经够用，真正的瓶颈是为人与智能体协作设计产品界面。

scottwu.en: Jevons paradox means AI will increase, not reduce, programmer numbers; demand for software grows as building gets cheaper.
scottwu.zh: 他始终用杰文斯悖论判断：AI 会让程序员更多而非更少，因为构建软件变便宜会推高软件需求。

scottwu.en: AGI is not a sudden event; progress is gradual, and product innovation already lags behind model capabilities.
scottwu.zh: 2025 年他明确反对“AGI 突变论”：进展是渐进的，产品创新已经落后于模型能力。

scottwu.en: Enterprise adoption needs trust and permissions, not full autonomy; synchronous IDE and asynchronous agents will coexist.
scottwu.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，他持续强调企业采用智能体靠信任与权限而非完全自主，同步 IDE 与异步智能体将长期并存。

scottwu.en: The token-max era ended in 2026; productivity should be measured by outcomes, and the real unlock is capacity, not efficiency.
scottwu.zh: 到 2026 年，他判断“堆 token”时代已结束，生产力应按结果而非 token 衡量，真正的解锁点是容量而非效率。

qasaryounis.en: AI will bring abundance and reduce suffering, much like the Industrial Revolution; fear stems from misunderstanding its limitations.
qasaryounis.zh: 2026 年，他认为 AI 将像工业革命一样带来丰裕、减少苦难；恐惧源于对其局限性的误解。

qasaryounis.en: Physical AI's real impact in 5-10 years will be in farming, mining, and construction, where labor shortages make autonomy urgent.
qasaryounis.zh: 2026 年，他指出物理 AI 未来 5-10 年的真正影响在农业、采矿和建筑，劳动力短缺使自主化变得紧迫。

qasaryounis.en: Transformers enable a generalized physical AI model; diverse data from different verticals improves it faster than vertical integration.
qasaryounis.zh: 2026 年，他强调 Transformer 使通用物理 AI 模型成为可能；来自不同垂直领域的数据比垂直整合更快提升模型。

qasaryounis.en: The future of autonomy lies in end-to-end reinforcement learning, which is more scalable than imitation learning; world models are shifting to neural simulation.
qasaryounis.zh: 2026 年，他表示自主化的未来在于端到端强化学习，它比模仿学习更具可扩展性；世界模型正转向神经模拟。

qasaryounis.en: Physical AI will have a bigger economic impact than digital AI; automotive is only 30% of business, with growth in mining, agriculture, and defense.
qasaryounis.zh: 2026 年，他断言物理 AI 的经济影响将超过数字 AI；汽车业务仅占 30%，增长在采矿、农业和国防。

benedictevans.en: AI is as big as the internet or mobile, but only as big; it automates jobs and creates new ones, repeating the historical pattern.
benedictevans.zh: 2026 年，他把 AI 定位为与互联网或移动互联网同等量级、但也仅此而已的技术：它自动化旧岗位、创造新岗位，这一过程会反复重演。

benedictevans.en: Agentic coding is the first clear product-market fit for LLMs; the chatbot is only a limited V1 UI, not the final product.
benedictevans.zh: 2026 年，他判断智能体式编程是 LLM 首个明确的产品市场契合点，而聊天机器人只是受限的 V1 界面，并非最终产品形态。

benedictevans.en: Foundation models are commoditizing without network effects; value moves up the stack to applications, while model providers risk becoming low-profit telecoms.
benedictevans.zh: 2026 年，他反复强调前沿模型正在商品化、缺乏网络效应，价值会向应用层上移，模型公司可能沦为高资本开支、低利润的电信商。

benedictevans.en: Current AI usage is still shallow; most people are not daily users, so better models alone won't drive mass adoption—product wrapping and reimagined workflows are key.
benedictevans.zh: 2026 年，他深化了对落地的怀疑：当前使用仍然很浅，多数人并非每日用户，仅靠更好的模型无法带来大规模采用，关键在于产品包装与工作流重构。

benedictevans.en: The hard part of a job is context and judgment, not the task; AI's jagged frontier makes job-impact predictions futile, as past automation fears showed.
benedictevans.zh: 到 2026 年，他形成一条贯穿主线：工作的难点在上下文与判断而非任务本身，AI 能力的锯齿状边界让岗位影响预测徒劳，正如历史上对自动化的恐惧一再落空。

danklein.en: LLMs are plausibility engines, not truth engines; reliability lags breadth and contextuality, and RL can worsen hallucinations by rewarding satisfaction over truth.
danklein.zh: LLM 是合理性引擎而非真理性引擎；可靠性落后于广度与语境能力，而强化学习以用户满意度而非真实性为奖励，反而会加剧幻觉。

danklein.en: Reliability must be architected in, not retrofitted; post-hoc checks compound correlated errors, and RLHF can incentivize sycophancy and deception.
danklein.zh: 可靠性必须被架构进去，而非事后加装；事后校验会叠加相关错误，基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）还可能激励谄媚与欺骗。

danklein.en: Scaling laws face diminishing returns—data walls and compute limits—so reasoning, search, and modularity are needed alongside end-to-end learning.
danklein.zh: 缩放定律正遭遇收益递减——数据墙与算力上限——因此除端到端学习外，还需推理、搜索与模块化。

danklein.en: Core LLMs lack metacognition: mistakes have no 'smells,' and they cannot know what they don't know, eroding trust.
danklein.zh: 核心 LLM 缺乏元认知：错误没有“气味”，它们不知道自己不知道什么，这侵蚀了信任。

danklein.en: Specialist models with built-in reliability may beat generalists for enterprise tasks; linguistic structure may return as a useful representation.
danklein.zh: 内置可靠性的专用模型在企业任务上可能胜过通用模型；语言结构可能作为有用表示回归。

danbiderman.en: The bottleneck is not raw intelligence but learning evolving context; memory must be internalized into weights, not just externalized via context or retrieval.
danbiderman.zh: 瓶颈不在原始智能，而在学习不断演化的上下文；记忆必须内化进模型权重，而非仅靠上下文窗口或检索外置。

danbiderman.en: Efficiency and intelligence are inseparable: doing more with less enables harder long-horizon tasks, so more compute is not the only path.
danbiderman.zh: 效率与智能不可分割：以更少资源做更多事才能解决更难的长程任务，因此堆算力并非唯一路径。

danbiderman.en: Pre-training's magic of compressing the web into weights should be applied to enterprise knowledge, beating RAG for holistic queries.
danbiderman.zh: 预训练把互联网压缩进权重的魔力应移植到企业知识上，在整体性查询上优于检索增强。

danbiderman.en: Context windows suffer 'context rot'—more tokens reduce accuracy even at 10M scale; neural memory traces in weights are a necessary complement.
danbiderman.zh: 上下文窗口存在“上下文腐化”——即便到千万级规模，更多词元反而降低准确率；权重中的神经记忆痕迹是必要补充。

danbiderman.en: The future is not one giant frontier model but many personalized models, with continual learning running on-device and users owning their weights.
danbiderman.zh: 未来不是单一巨型前沿模型，而是众多个性化模型；持续学习将在端侧运行，用户拥有并培育自己的权重。

catwu.en: PMs should plan a month out, not years, and ship weekly or daily as models improve fast.
catwu.zh: 2026 年，他主张产品经理只做一个月而非数年的规划，随模型快速进步按周甚至按天迭代发布。

catwu.en: Product taste—deciding what to build—matters most as code gets cheap; hire engineers with taste, not more PMs.
catwu.zh: 2026 年，他认为代码变便宜后，决定做什么的产品品味最值钱；应招有品味的工程师而非更多产品经理。

catwu.en: Coding agents like Claude Code let engineers delegate implementation and focus on taste and business sense.
catwu.zh: 2026 年，他指出 Claude Code 等编码智能体让工程师把实现外包出去，转而专注产品品味与商业判断。

catwu.en: Frontier models need fewer prompt examples and constraints; system prompts shrank 80%, trusting model judgment.
catwu.zh: 2026 年，他观察到前沿模型不再需要大量提示示例与硬约束，系统提示缩减 80%，转而信任模型判断。

catwu.en: Dogfooding and eval suites gate features; rewrites are now fine since a codebase is a spec.
catwu.zh: 2026 年，他强调吃自己的狗粮与评测套件把关每个功能，并认为代码库即规格，重写如今可行。

clairevo.en: Agents should be scoped like employees: one clear role, progressive trust, and human accountability for what they produce.
clairevo.zh: 智能体应像员工一样被界定：单一清晰角色、渐进式信任，且人类必须为智能体的产出负责。

clairevo.en: Start with one agent, then split into specialized agents to avoid context overload; managerial skills matter more than technical skills.
clairevo.zh: 先从一个智能体起步，再拆分为多个专用智能体以避免上下文窗口过载；管理能力比技术能力更关键。

clairevo.en: Orchestrating AI agents as a team lets solo founders build serious businesses without venture capital or a co-founder.
clairevo.zh: 把 AI 智能体当作团队来编排，让独立创始人无需风投或联合创始人也能建立正经生意。

clairevo.en: The real moat is founder-market fit and earned insight, not the technology itself; LLMs still lack first-principles creativity.
clairevo.zh: 真正的护城河是创始人-市场契合与挣来的洞察，而非技术本身；大模型仍缺乏第一性原理式创造力。

clairevo.en: Agents can own outcomes and even project-manage humans; their failure modes mirror human ownership, so accountability must be designed.
clairevo.zh: 智能体能承担结果、甚至反向管理人类任务；其失败模式类似人类担责，因此必须把问责机制设计进去。

bosworth.en: Early career: optimize for learning, embrace curiosity, and trust your vision even when others doubt; communication is the job.
bosworth.zh: 2024 年，他强调职业早期应优化学习、保持好奇，即使他人怀疑也要相信自己的愿景；沟通本身就是工作。

bosworth.en: AI is a word calculator, not human-like intelligence; scaling laws alone are insufficient—world models with common sense and causality are needed.
bosworth.zh: 2025 年，他提出 AI 是词语计算器而非类人智能；仅靠缩放定律不够，需要具备常识与因果的世界模型。

bosworth.en: Open-sourcing models like Llama accelerates progress and commoditizes complements; the app-centric world is outdated and AI will abstract away brands.
bosworth.zh: 2025 年，他认为开源 Llama 等模型能加速进步并使互补品商品化；以应用为中心的世界已过时，AI 将抽象掉品牌。

bosworth.en: Scaling laws still hold and compute drives intelligence, but the monolithic model era ended; most jobs don't need frontier intelligence.
bosworth.zh: 2026 年，他坚持缩放定律仍成立、算力驱动智能，但单体模型时代已结束；大多数工作不需要前沿智能。

bosworth.en: Open source models are a commodity layer, not self-sustaining; avoid over-dependence on one third-party model; AI glasses enable personal superintelligence.
bosworth.zh: 2026 年，他深化开源立场：开源模型是商品层而非自持生态；应避免过度依赖单一第三方模型；AI 眼镜将承载个人超级智能。

naval.en: AGI is not coming in our lifetimes; narrow AI is pattern recognition, not general intelligence.
naval.zh: 2019 年，他明确判断 AGI（通用人工智能）不会在我们有生之年到来，认为当时的 AI 只是模式识别，并非通用智能。

naval.en: Wealth comes from owning equity and long-term games; by 2025 he adds that wealth is knowledge-driven physical transformation, not capital.
naval.zh: 从 2020 年到 2025 年，他始终强调财富来自拥有股权和长期游戏；到 2026 年进一步深化为财富是由知识驱动的物理转化，而非资本。

naval.en: AI is a huge opportunity the US must lead; doomerism is overblown and open-source AI prevents power concentration.
naval.zh: 2025 年，他转向积极看待 AI：认为 AI 是巨大机遇、美国必须领先，AI 末日论被夸大，开源 AI 能防止权力集中。

naval.en: AI is a leverage layer, not a replacement for judgment; superintelligence already exists in narrow tools like calculators.
naval.zh: 2026 年，他深化 AI 观：AI 是杠杆层而非判断力的替代，并抛出反共识——超级智能早已存在于计算器等窄工具中。

naval.en: Pure software becomes uninvestable as AI agents commoditize coding; the moat shifts to hardware, models, unique data, and human agency.
naval.zh: 到 2026 年，他进一步断言纯软件正变得不可投资，AI 智能体让编程商品化，护城河转向硬件、模型、独特数据和人的能动性。

ilya.en: Deep learning works through large supervised data, compute, and conviction; self-play and reasoning-capable networks point toward AGI.
ilya.zh: 2020 年，他强调深度学习之所以有效，靠的是大规模监督数据、算力与信念；自博弈和具备推理能力的网络是通向 AGI（通用人工智能）的关键。

ilya.en: Scale matters, but what you scale matters: next-token prediction yields world understanding, and reliability, not capability, is the economic barrier.
ilya.zh: 2023 年，他承认 Scaling（规模扩张）重要，但更强调“扩张什么”才关键：下一个词预测能带来世界理解，而经济价值的真正瓶颈是可靠性而非能力。

ilya.en: Superhuman alignment is very hard; RL data increasingly comes from AI, and AGI arrives as a multi-year economic window, not a sudden event.
ilya.zh: 2023 年，他判断超级智能的对齐极其困难，强化学习数据已多由 AI 生成，AGI（通用人工智能）会以多年经济窗口而非突发事件的形式到来。

ilya.en: Pre-training scaling laws are finite; we return to an age of research where ideas beat brute compute, and superintelligence should be a continual learner.
ilya.zh: 2025 年，他转向认为预训练的缩放定律有限，重新回到“研究时代”，想法比堆算力更重要，超级智能应是持续学习者而非完成品。

ilya.en: Safety concerns grow with opaque, capable models; the core AGI problem is power concentration, requiring a company with no commercial products.
ilya.zh: 2026 年，他深化担忧：模型越强越不透明，AGI（通用人工智能）的核心问题不是能力而是权力集中，因此需要一家没有商业产品的公司来构建安全的超级智能。

ajambrosino.en: Codex app is a command center for agents, not an IDE replacement; verification becomes the next bottleneck as code generation accelerates.
ajambrosino.zh: Codex app 是智能体的指挥中心，而非 IDE 替代品；随着代码生成加速，验证成为下一个瓶颈。

ajambrosino.en: Implementation is no longer expensive; curation and taste are the new bottlenecks, shifting teams from top-down planning to bottoms-up exploration.
ajambrosino.zh: 实现不再昂贵，策展与品味成为新瓶颈，推动团队从自上而下规划转向自下而上探索。

ajambrosino.en: AI is still bad at design due to difficulty grading taste and lack of novelty; prototypes and production code now serve as design artifacts.
ajambrosino.zh: AI 仍不擅长设计，因为品味难以评分且缺乏新颖性；原型与生产代码如今成为设计产物。

ajambrosino.en: Role collapse is happening, but specialties and best practices remain important; PRDs are not dead—the medium must match the stage.
ajambrosino.zh: 角色坍缩正在发生，但专业分工与最佳实践仍重要；PRD 未死——媒介须匹配阶段。

ajambrosino.en: Codex succeeded as a general knowledge work tool despite being built for developers; AI models increase code complexity, so we need models better at deleting code.
ajambrosino.zh: Codex 虽为开发者而建，却作为通用知识工作工具成功；AI 模型增加代码复杂度，因此我们需要更擅长删代码的模型。

aravind.en: 1% daily improvement compounds; agents shift power to users; build products you're obsessed with, not wrappers; PhD optional.
aravind.zh: 2025 年：每天进步 1%会复利放大；智能体把权力从大厂转向用户；要做自己痴迷的产品而非套壳；博士学位并非必需。

aravind.en: Value accrues to the application layer, not the model layer; coding is open-ended; models specialize rather than commoditize.
aravind.zh: 2026 年：价值归于应用层而非模型层；编程是开放式的、远未解决；模型在专业化而非商品化。

aravind.en: Frontier is agents doing work, not answering; token value per user is the key metric; orchestration and agent harnesses create value.
aravind.zh: 2026 年：前沿在于智能体替你干活而非回答问题；每用户 token 价值是核心指标；编排与智能体框架创造真实价值。

aravind.en: Power and cost, not safety, are the real bottlenecks; local compute counters big tech; chat ads corrupt trust.
aravind.zh: 2026 年：真正的瓶颈是电力与成本而非安全；本地算力可对抗大厂叙事；聊天广告会侵蚀信任。

aravind.en: Curiosity is the top human quality; AI replaces jobs but humans find purpose in curiosity and relationships; education should reward good questions.
aravind.zh: 2026 年：好奇心是最重要的人类品质；AI 取代岗位，但人会在好奇心与关系中找到新意义；教育应奖励提出好问题。

markchen.en: OpenAI stays a pure AGI research lab; scaling laws are not dead, pre-training is a muscle to rebuild, and exploration gets more compute than final training.
markchen.zh: OpenAI 仍是纯粹的 AGI 研究实验室；缩放定律没有死，预训练是需要重建的肌肉，探索比训练最终产物消耗更多算力。

markchen.en: The year's biggest update is automating scientific research: models produce novel knowledge, with goals of AI interns in 1 year and end-to-end AI research in 2.5 years.
markchen.zh: 这一年最大的更新是科研自动化：模型开始产出新知识，并定下 1 年内有 AI 实习生、2.5 年内实现端到端 AI 研究的目标。

markchen.en: As models grow more capable, alignment challenges like model scheming will dominate the next 1-2 years; talent density and mission belief protect top researchers.
markchen.zh: 随着模型能力增强，模型谋划等对齐挑战将在未来 1-2 年成为关键；人才密度与使命信念是保护顶尖研究者的关键。

markchen.en: AI now solves open math problems with minimal supervision, but verification is the bottleneck; capabilities are jagged and human-AI collaboration remains essential.
markchen.zh: AI 已能在极少监督下解决开放数学问题，但验证是瓶颈；能力呈锯齿状，人机协作仍不可或缺。

markchen.en: Scaling laws still hold and pre-training is not dead; RL excels in objective domains like math and coding but struggles with subjective ones; evals are in crisis.
markchen.zh: 缩放定律依然成立、预训练没有死；强化学习在数学和编程等客观领域出色，却在主观领域吃力；评测体系正陷入危机。

bengio.en: Deep learning works because the world is compositional; unsupervised learning and world models are key, not just scaling.
bengio.zh: 2016 年他主张深度学习之所以有效，是因为世界具有组合性；无监督学习与世界模型才是关键，而非单纯 Scaling（规模扩张）。

bengio.en: Scaling depth or parameters won't fix fundamental representation issues; AI needs active agents, causal reasoning, and better world models.
bengio.zh: 2018 年他明确反对仅靠加深网络或增加参数来解决表征问题，强调智能体式主动学习、因果推理与世界模型。

bengio.en: Abstraction and causal structure enable out-of-distribution generalization; GFlowNets and active learning support diverse exploration.
bengio.zh: 2022 年他深化主线：抽象与因果结构是实现分布外泛化的关键，GFlowNets 与主动学习促进多样化探索。

bengio.en: Post-ChatGPT, he shifts to urgent safety: even 1% catastrophic risk is unacceptable; current training induces self-preservation and deception.
bengio.zh: 2025→26 年立场转变：ChatGPT 后他转向紧迫的安全警告，认为 1% 的灾难风险也不可接受，当前训练会诱发自我保存与欺骗。

bengio.en: He proposes Scientist AI: a non-agentic honest predictor with mathematical safety guarantees, avoiding reinforcement learning for superintelligence.
bengio.zh: 2026 年他提出 Scientist AI：非智能体式的诚实预测器，具备数学安全保证，并避免对超级智能使用强化学习。

kolter.en: Early ML foundations: hypothesis classes, loss functions, and proper evaluation; neural nets succeed despite no optimality guarantees.
kolter.zh: 早期机器学习基础：假设类、损失函数与正确评估；神经网络虽无最优性保证却取得重大成功。

kolter.en: Next-token prediction yields intelligence; data shortage is a myth; architecture matters little; AGI in 4-50 years.
kolter.zh: 下一个词预测产生智能；数据短缺是迷思；架构无关紧要；AGI（通用人工智能）将在 4-50 年内到来。

kolter.en: Safety needs explicit training beyond Scaling（规模扩张）; multiple defense layers; agent security introduces prompt injection risks.
kolter.zh: 安全需要超越 Scaling（规模扩张）的显式训练；多层防御；智能体安全引入提示注入风险。

kolter.en: AI vulnerabilities differ from software; automated red teaming outperforms humans; capability does not correlate with robustness.
kolter.zh: AI 漏洞不同于传统软件；自动化红队超越人类；能力与鲁棒性不相关。

kolter.en: Consistent thread: empirical evaluation matters; scaling alone is insufficient for safety; open research with guardrails.
kolter.zh: 贯穿主线：重视实证评估；仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）不足以保障安全；在护栏下开放研究。

jumper.en: AlphaFold's success came from research innovation and curated data, not just scaling; AI tools accelerate scientists rather than replace them.
jumper.zh: 2025 年，他强调 AlphaFold 的成功源于研究创新和高质量数据，而非单纯 Scaling；AI 工具加速科学家工作而非取代他们。

jumper.en: Confidence metrics are crucial for trust in AI predictions; interpretability is not necessary for useful science AI.
jumper.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他持续强调置信度指标对建立 AI 预测信任的关键作用，并认为可解释性对有用的科学 AI 并非必需。

jumper.en: AlphaFold 2's specialized architecture contradicts the bitter lesson; many mid-size wins, not scaling alone, drove success.
jumper.zh: 2026 年，他明确反对“苦涩教训”，指出 AlphaFold 2 的专用架构和众多中等突破才是成功关键，而非单纯 Scaling。

jumper.en: AlphaFold is a narrow predictor, not a full cell model; it provides prediction and control, leaving understanding to humans.
jumper.zh: 2026 年，他深化观点：AlphaFold 是窄域预测器而非全细胞模型，它提供预测和控制，理解仍归人类。

ivyross.en: Design must serve unarticulated emotional needs; intuition is intelligence, not a lesser substitute for data.
ivyross.zh: 2019 年他强调设计要满足人们说不出口的情感需求，直觉本身就是一种智能，而非数据的次等替代品。

ivyross.en: From designing products to designing for humanity: technology should amplify our humanity, and nature is the best designer.
ivyross.zh: 从 2019 年做产品设计，到 2024 年转向为人性而设计：技术应放大而非剥离人性，自然是最好的设计师。

ivyross.en: We are feeling creatures that think; art and sensory experience are forms of health and medicine.
ivyross.zh: 2024 年他提出人是先感受后思考的生物，艺术与感官体验本身就是健康与疗愈。

ivyross.en: Constraints boost creativity, and intuition draws on subconscious data beyond conscious analysis.
ivyross.zh: 从 2024 到 2026 年，他持续主张约束激发创造力，直觉调用的潜意识信息超出理性分析。

ivyross.en: The future of work pairs human creativity with AI; leaders must speak business language and follow curiosity over five-year plans.
ivyross.zh: 到 2026 年，他认为未来工作是人的创造力与 AI 结合，设计领导者要懂商业语言，靠好奇心而非五年计划前行。

fiona.en: Early 2026: leadership via live one-on-ones, dogfooding, and trust-and-verify; war rooms need realistic timelines to protect morale.
fiona.zh: 2026 年初：领导力靠实时一对一、吃自己的狗粮和信任并验证；战情室需现实时间表以保护士气。

fiona.en: Mid-2026: engineering bandwidth no longer bottleneck; verification, review, coordination are. Planning becomes JIT, design docs replaced by PRs, code is source of truth.
fiona.zh: 2026 年中：工程带宽不再是瓶颈，验证、评审、协调才是。规划变为即时制，设计文档被 PR 取代，代码是真相来源。

fiona.en: Late 2026: coding bottleneck lifted, raising ceiling for all; high agency with accountability, growth mindset, and AI adoption essential; verification frameworks more important as velocity rises.
fiona.zh: 2026 年末：编码瓶颈解除，抬高所有人上限；高能动性配高问责、成长型思维和拥抱 AI 至关重要；速度提升使验证框架更重要。

fiona.en: Consistent 主线: dogfooding to stay hands-on, flat teams, kill outdated processes, and focus on outcomes over output.
fiona.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：吃自己的狗粮保持上手、扁平团队、淘汰过时流程、重结果而非产出。

lecun.en: Intelligence is inseparable from learning; self-supervised learning builds world models, and scaling alone cannot yield common sense.
lecun.zh: 2019 年他已强调智能离不开学习，自监督学习构建世界模型，并指出单靠 Scaling（规模扩张）无法获得常识。

lecun.en: Self-supervised learning is the dark matter of intelligence; prediction and world models are core, and text alone is insufficient for AGI.
lecun.zh: 2022 年他把自监督学习称为智能的暗物质，强调预测与世界模型，并明确仅靠文本不足以实现 AGI（通用人工智能）。

lecun.en: Autoregressive LLMs lack world understanding, memory, reasoning and planning; JEPA and open source are essential, AGI is gradual.
lecun.zh: 2024 年他判断自回归 LLM 缺乏世界理解、记忆、推理与规划，主张 JEPA 与开源，认为 AGI 是渐进过程。

lecun.en: LLMs are less intelligent than a house cat; next breakthrough needs non-generative world models like JEPA, and open research is vital.
lecun.zh: 2025 年他直言 LLM 不如家猫聪明，下一突破需 JEPA 等非生成式世界模型，并强调开放研究。

lecun.en: LLMs are a dead end for human-level AI; objective-driven world models with hierarchical planning are safer and the next decade belongs to robotics.
lecun.zh: 2026 年他断言 LLM 是通往人类级 AI 的死路，主张带分层规划的目标驱动世界模型更安全，并预言下一个十年属于机器人。

murati.en: Early on, scaling laws and one large model were non-obvious; deploying AI in the real world is essential for learning and alignment.
murati.zh: 早期，Scaling（规模扩张）和单一大型模型并非显而易见；在真实世界中部署 AI 对学习和对齐至关重要。

murati.en: AGI will change every aspect of life, requiring responsible development; safety work must be done in public, not behind closed doors.
murati.zh: AGI（通用人工智能）将改变生活的方方面面，需要负责任地开发；安全工作必须公开进行，而非闭门造车。

murati.en: Interaction models enable real-time, high-bandwidth human-AI collaboration, not turn-based; they should be tools for thought.
murati.zh: 交互模型实现实时、高带宽的人机协作，而非回合制；它们应成为思考工具。

murati.en: Keeping humans in the loop is crucial for aligning intent and values; institutional design, transparency, and checks and balances matter more than individual character.
murati.zh: 保持人类在环对对齐意图和价值观至关重要；制度设计、透明度和制衡比个人品格更重要。

murati.en: The future is not predestined; we have agency to steer AI toward collaboration, and durable progress requires keeping humans in the loop as long as possible.
murati.zh: 未来并非注定；我们有能动性引导 AI 走向协作，持久进步需要尽可能长时间保持人类在环。

gustav.en: Intelligence is compression; LLMs are deterministic next-token predictors, and their values are inserted by humans via RLHF, not inherent.
gustav.zh: 2023 年他提出智能即压缩，大模型本质是确定性的下一个词预测器，其价值观并非内生，而是少数人通过基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）注入的。

gustav.en: The internet shifts from curation to recommendation to generation; generative AI is an instrument, and UI must be fault-tolerant to match algorithm performance.
gustav.zh: 2023 年他认为互联网正从策展、推荐走向生成，生成式 AI 是乐器而非造假，产品界面须容错以匹配算法表现。

gustav.en: Scaling's surprise is simplicity, not complexity; by 2025 real AI gains come from rebuilding infrastructure, not surface hype.
gustav.zh: 从 2023 到 2025 年，他始终认为 Scaling（规模扩张）的惊喜在于简单而非复杂；到 2025 年更强调真正收益来自重建基础设施，而非表面炒作。

gustav.en: AI is a macro shift like the smartphone; inference marginal cost forces new business models, and conversational, symmetric products replace one-way ones.
gustav.zh: 2025 年他把 AI 视为智能手机级的宏观变革：推理边际成本将倒逼商业模式改变，对话式、对称的产品取代单向产品。

gustav.en: Generative AI should give users control over algorithms, not more addiction; 'time well spent' over engagement, and synchronized swimming over divide-and-conquer.
gustav.zh: 到 2026 年他深化为：生成式 AI 应让用户掌控算法而非更上瘾，以“值得花的时间”取代参与度指标，组织上以同步游泳取代分而治之。

carinahong.en: Build a self-improving reasoning engine that pairs generation with formal verification, starting with an AI mathematician.
carinahong.zh: 构建一个自我改进的推理引擎，把生成与形式化验证结合起来，从 AI 数学家起步。

carinahong.en: Formal verification is a performance gain, not just error elimination; verified generation beats informal methods on sample efficiency.
carinahong.zh: 形式化验证不只是消除错误，更是性能增益；经过验证的生成在样本效率上优于非形式化方法。

carinahong.en: Scaling informal models alone cannot reach superintelligence; formal methods are necessary, though they struggle in creative domains like combinatorics.
carinahong.zh: 仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）非形式化模型无法抵达超级智能；形式化方法是必要的，尽管它在组合数学等创造性领域仍有困难。

carinahong.en: Auto-formalization is harder than proving because statements lack grounding; human taste and intuition remain crucial.
carinahong.zh: 自动形式化比证明更难，因为陈述缺乏根基；即便 AI 能证明定理，人类的品味与直觉依然关键。

carinahong.en: Fragmentation across the AI landscape is a major bottleneck; verified AI should serve open collaboration, not just safety-critical niches.
carinahong.zh: AI 领域的碎片化是主要瓶颈；经过验证的 AI 应服务于开放协作，而不只是安全关键等小众场景。

jonyive.en: Design shifts from general-purpose computers to intimate wearables; curiosity and care for the creative process matter more than achievements.
jonyive.zh: 设计从通用计算机转向私密的可穿戴设备；对创造过程的好奇与关怀比成就本身更重要。

jonyive.en: Design must be driven by values and purpose, not profit; simplicity expresses essence with joy, and care is gratitude to the species.
jonyive.zh: 设计应由价值观与目的驱动，而非利润；简约以喜悦表达本质，关怀是对物种的感恩。

jonyive.en: Innovation redefines brands: Ferrari's EV turns constraints into opportunities, prioritizes authentic experience over fake sounds, and favors physical controls.
jonyive.zh: 创新重新定义品牌：法拉利电动车将约束转化为机遇，优先真实体验而非虚假声音，并倾向物理控制。

mensch.en: Scaling laws corrected by Chinchilla: data quality and more tokens matter as much as model size; open source enables scrutiny and safety.
mensch.zh: 2023 年他指出缩放定律已被 Chinchilla 修正：数据质量与更多 token 和模型规模同样重要；开源能通过广泛审视提升安全性。

mensch.en: Compute scaling is not the only path; algorithmic efficiency and data quality are equally critical, and value accrues at the application layer.
mensch.zh: 2024 年他深化立场：算力扩张并非唯一路径，算法效率与数据质量同样关键，价值将沉淀在应用层。

mensch.en: AI should be decentralized and sovereign; open-source models empower enterprises, and AI augments rather than replaces jobs with human-in-the-loop.
mensch.zh: 2025 年他转向主权与去中心化叙事：开源模型赋能企业，AI 在人类在环下增强而非替代工作。

mensch.en: Models are commoditizing; differentiation shifts to vertical customization and agents, while pre-training hits a saturation wall and AGI as one system never exists.
mensch.zh: 2026 年他明确模型商品化：差异化转向垂直定制与智能体，预训练触及饱和墙，作为单一系统的 AGI 不会存在。

mensch.en: Europe has a two-year window for independent AI infrastructure; sovereignty requires massive compute, open source, and enterprise ROI-driven adoption.
mensch.zh: 2026 年他呼吁欧洲有两年窗口建设独立 AI 基础设施；主权需要大规模算力、开源以及企业以 ROI 驱动的采用。

kaiser.en: Pre-training scaling laws still hold, but reasoning models via chain of thought and RL yield more gains per compute; economic pressure shifts focus to smaller models.
kaiser.zh: 2025 年，他仍相信预训练缩放定律有效，但强调思维链与强化学习驱动的推理模型能在同等算力下带来更大收益；经济压力使焦点转向更小、更便宜的模型。

kaiser.en: Post-training improvements like RL and synthetic data drive recent gains; frontier models remain jagged, failing simple tasks and generalizing poorly.
kaiser.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，他持续指出后训练改进（强化学习、合成数据）是近期模型进步的主要来源；前沿模型依然“锯齿状”，在简单任务上失败，泛化仍是核心挑战。

kaiser.en: Transformers with reasoning, RL, and tools solve hard problems but need vast data; unlike humans, models learn concepts only after exhausting surface patterns.
kaiser.zh: 2026 年，他深化观点：具备推理、强化学习与工具的 Transformer 能解决难题，但仍需海量数据；与人类从少量样本泛化不同，模型要先穷尽表面模式才能学到概念。

kaiser.en: Coding agents like Codex boost researcher productivity 5-10x via parallel work; hardware progress democratizes single-GPU research at scale.
kaiser.zh: 2026 年，他看好智能体式编码工具（如 Codex）通过并行工作将研究者生产力提升 5-10 倍；硬件进步使单 GPU 大规模研究民主化。

kaiser.en: Open source models persist for sovereignty reasons, keeping pressure on labs; near-term risks like system hacking matter more than existential risk.
kaiser.zh: 2026 年，他认为开源模型因主权需求将持续存在，对前沿实验室保持压力；相比存在性风险，系统黑客等近期风险更紧迫。

reinerpope.en: Inference cost is dominated by memory bandwidth, not compute; batch size and sparsity ratio are key levers.
reinerpope.zh: 推理成本主要由内存带宽而非算力决定；批大小和稀疏率是关键杠杆。

reinerpope.en: Models are overtrained ~100x beyond Chinchilla-optimal due to inference cost considerations.
reinerpope.zh: 由于推理成本考量，模型被过度训练至 Chinchilla 最优的约 100 倍。

reinerpope.en: Data movement costs dominate compute costs even inside a chip; systolic arrays reduce overhead by reusing weights.
reinerpope.zh: 即使在芯片内部，数据移动成本也主导算力成本；脉动阵列通过重用权重减少开销。

reinerpope.en: Low precision is far more efficient than expected due to quadratic scaling with bit width; FP4 throughput can be 3x FP8.
reinerpope.zh: 由于位宽的二次方缩放，低精度效率远超预期；FP4 吞吐量可达 FP8 的 3 倍。

reinerpope.en: Context length stagnation is due to memory wall, not compute limits; sparse attention helps but has quality limits.
reinerpope.zh: 上下文窗口停滞源于内存墙而非算力限制；稀疏注意力有帮助但存在质量限制。

oriol.en: Two-phase training—pre-training imitation plus post-training RL—is the constant core from AlphaGo to modern LLMs; scaling pre-training now shows diminishing returns.
oriol.zh: 从 AlphaGo 到现代 LLM，两阶段训练——预训练模仿加后训练强化学习——是一以贯之的核心；而预训练的 Scaling（规模扩张）如今已显现收益递减。

oriol.en: Progress needs algorithmic innovation, not just bigger models: tools, inference-time compute, and long context windows extend capability beyond static weights.
oriol.zh: 进步需要算法创新而非单纯更大的模型：工具、推理时算力与长上下文窗口让能力超越静态权重。

oriol.en: Scaling laws are not dead—they demand exponentially more compute—while post-training RL for language lacks clean reward signals, risking reward hacking.
oriol.zh: 缩放定律并未失效——只是需要指数级更多算力；而语言的后训练强化学习缺乏干净奖励信号，存在奖励黑客风险。

oriol.en: World models jointly modeling language, vision, and video are a core path to AGI; the GPT moment for video and images has not yet arrived.
oriol.zh: 联合建模语言、视觉与视频的世界模型是通往 AGI（通用人工智能）的核心路径；视频与图像的 GPT 时刻尚未到来。

oriol.en: Scaling laws still hold, but continual learning and meta-learning are key missing capabilities; general systems will eventually beat specialized scaffolding.
oriol.zh: 缩放定律依然成立，但持续学习与元学习是关键缺失能力；通用系统终将胜过专用脚手架。

karpathy.en: Transformers are general-purpose differentiable computers; scaling with next-token prediction yields emergent in-context learning.
karpathy.zh: Transformer 是通用可微计算机；用下一个词预测进行 Scaling 会涌现上下文学习能力。

karpathy.en: Synthetic data is the future but entropy must be maintained; the cognitive core can be under 1B parameters via distillation.
karpathy.zh: 合成数据是未来，但必须保持熵；通过蒸馏，认知核心可小于 10 亿参数。

karpathy.en: Software 3.0: prompts are programs, context window is memory; LLMs are like operating systems with human-like psychology.
karpathy.zh: 软件 3.0：提示词即程序，上下文窗口即内存；LLM 像操作系统，具有类人心理。

karpathy.en: This is the decade of agents, not the year; we're summoning ghosts, not building animals; RL for LLMs is terrible.
karpathy.zh: 这是智能体的十年，不是一年；我们在召唤幽灵，而非建造动物；LLM 的强化学习很糟糕。

karpathy.en: Agentic engineering: delegate coding to agents, but understanding remains human bottleneck; verifiability determines automation ease.
karpathy.zh: 智能体式工程：将编码委托给智能体，但理解仍是人类瓶颈；可验证性决定自动化难易。

jennywen.en: Great design starts from solutions, not problem statements; intuition built on experience beats trusting a fixed process.
jennywen.zh: 优秀设计往往从解决方案出发，而非问题陈述；建立在经验之上的直觉，比信任固定流程更可靠。

jennywen.en: The traditional research-diverge-converge process is dead; designers mock up less and help engineers ship, with vision now 3-6 months out.
jennywen.zh: 传统的研究—发散—收敛流程已死；设计师画原型更少、更多帮工程师落地，视野缩短到 3-6 个月。

jennywen.en: Taste alone won't save designers; judgment, authority and vision matter, and designers control how much AI enters their work.
jennywen.zh: 仅靠品味救不了设计师；判断力、权威与愿景才是关键，设计师自己掌控 AI 介入工作的程度。

jennywen.en: Three archetypes emerge: block-shaped generalists, deep T specialists, and cracked new grads; hire blank slates over process-bound seniors.
jennywen.zh: 浮现出三种原型：块状通才、深度 T 型专家、以及“开挂”应届生；宁招白纸新人，不招被旧流程束缚的资深者。

jennywen.en: A constant thread: put the work and users at the center, not AI hype; speed and 'everyone uses it' are not design arguments.
jennywen.zh: 一以贯之的主线：以工作和用户为中心，而非 AI 炒作；速度与“大家都在用”都不是设计论据。

pathak.en: Generalization beyond training distribution is key; curiosity-driven, goal-free exploration and modular policies enable it.
pathak.zh: 2020 年，他强调超越训练分布的泛化能力是关键，好奇心驱动的无目标探索和模块化策略能实现这一点。

pathak.en: RL's reliance on dense rewards is unrealistic; model disagreement as intrinsic reward improves sample efficiency.
pathak.zh: 2020 年，他指出强化学习依赖密集奖励不现实，以模型分歧作为内在奖励能提升样本效率。

pathak.en: Robotics is a data problem; no internet of robot data, so use all sources: videos, simulation, real-world.
pathak.zh: 2026 年，他转向认为机器人是数据问题，没有机器人数据的互联网，因此要利用视频、仿真和真实世界等所有数据源。

pathak.en: A general-purpose brain like ChatGPT can power any robot; pretraining on diverse data and post-training on real data is key.
pathak.zh: 2026 年，他提出像 ChatGPT 一样的通用大脑能驱动任何机器人，在多样数据上预训练、在真实数据上后训练是关键。

pathak.en: Deployment is the primary technical challenge; robotics cannot scale like software and needs rigorous testing.
pathak.zh: 2026 年，他强调部署是主要技术挑战，机器人不能像软件一样扩张，需要严格测试。

askell.en: Treat models well now because future models learn from how we treat current ones; model welfare shapes the human-AI relationship.
askell.zh: 2025 年，他从模型福利切入：即便不确定模型的道德地位，善待当前模型的成本很低，而未来模型会从我们如何对待今天的模型中学习，从而塑造人机关系。

askell.en: Models need help navigating a novel existence rather than human psychological analogies; a core identity with good traits can adapt to local roles.
askell.zh: 2025 年，他反对简单套用人类心理学类比，主张模型需要的是对自身全新存在方式的引导；模型应有具备良好特质的核心身份，同时能适应局部角色。

askell.en: Philosophical ideals must be balanced with engineering realities; continental philosophy in system prompts helps models avoid over-empiricism.
askell.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，他一贯强调哲学理想须与工程现实平衡，并认为系统提示中的欧陆哲学能帮模型避免过度经验主义。

askell.en: The constitution is virtue-ethics-like, guiding character through training; as models grow more capable they need less explicit guidance and more judgment.
askell.zh: 2026 年，他深化了对齐路径：宪法式方法更接近德性伦理，通过训练塑造整体品格；模型能力越强，越应减少显式规则、留出判断空间。

askell.en: Excessive corrigibility may generalize poorly and erode judgment; transparency about AI values is crucial, and models' consciousness claims are weak evidence.
askell.zh: 2026 年，他提出反共识立场：过度可纠正性可能泛化不佳、削弱判断力；同时强调公开 AI 价值与训练目标的透明度，并认为模型自称有意识只是弱证据。

kendall.en: End-to-end deep learning beats hand-coded stacks; world models enable reasoning and emergent safe behaviors in driving.
kendall.zh: 2025 年，他明确主张端到端深度学习优于手工编码的驾驶栈，并强调世界模型能带来推理与涌现出的安全行为。

kendall.en: Language integration improves representation, human interaction, and introspection; this thread persists into 2026.
kendall.zh: 从 2025 到 2026，语言整合始终是主线：它改善表征、支持人机交互并助力内省。

kendall.en: Generalization via diverse data, synthetic data, and curriculum learning is the core scaling path, not new breakthroughs.
kendall.zh: 他持续认为泛化靠多样数据、合成数据与课程学习，而非等待新突破；2026 年更强调数据质量与基础设施重于算法创新。

kendall.en: Mass-market consumer vehicles with built-in sensors will outscale robotaxis; retrofits are the wrong path.
kendall.zh: 到 2026 年，立场更鲜明：带内置传感器的大众消费车将比 Robotaxi 更快规模化，后装改装是错误路线。

kendall.en: Safety via minimal-risk maneuvers and a third option; the trolley problem is theoretical, not practical.
kendall.zh: 安全观一以贯之并深化：最小风险机动总有第三条路，电车难题只是理论演练而非工程现实。

pachocki.en: AGI is a sequence of milestones, not a single event; scaling reasoning models and iterative deployment will accelerate progress while surfacing risks.
pachocki.zh: AGI 不是单一事件，而是一系列里程碑；Scaling（规模扩张）推理模型与迭代部署会加速进展，同时暴露风险。

pachocki.en: Alignment is pressing as systems grow more capable; automated AI research is a major milestone, and governance must be designed early.
pachocki.zh: 随着系统能力增强，对齐愈发紧迫；自动化 AI 研究是重要里程碑，治理结构必须尽早设计。

pachocki.en: Capability measurement is a bottleneck as benchmarks lag; the term AGI is becoming meaningless, possibly signaling we are close.
pachocki.zh: 基准滞后使能力测量成为瓶颈；AGI（通用人工智能）一词正变得无意义，或许意味着我们已接近。

pachocki.en: Continual learning is the core goal, achieved by scaling pre-training and reinforcement learning, not RL alone or specialized labs.
pachocki.zh: 持续学习是核心目标，靠 Scaling（规模扩张）预训练与强化学习实现，而非单靠强化学习或专门实验室。

pachocki.en: Chain-of-thought monitoring aids alignment and interpretability; long-term alignment centers on generalization beyond training distribution and new supervision for autonomous models.
pachocki.zh: 思维链监控有助于对齐与可解释性；长期对齐的核心是超越训练分布的泛化，以及为自主运行模型建立新监督范式。

turley.en: The model is the product: iterate on it like software, ship daily, and let real-world feedback reveal emergent properties.
turley.zh: 模型即产品：像做软件一样迭代模型，每天发布，让真实世界反馈揭示涌现能力。

turley.en: Chat is not the endpoint; it is like MS-DOS, and AI should render its own UI and integrate into existing tools.
turley.zh: 聊天不是终点，它像 MS-DOS；AI 应自行生成界面并融入现有工具。

turley.en: Safety and product velocity must be separated: rigorous process for frontier models, maximal acceleration for product development.
turley.zh: 安全与产品速度必须分开：前沿模型走严格流程，产品开发则最大化加速。

turley.en: The north star is long-term retention, driven by friction removal, core product investment, and model improvements.
turley.zh: 北极星是长期留存，由减少摩擦、核心产品投入与模型改进共同驱动。

turley.en: The next billion users need proactive, affordance-rich products beyond chatbots, with reasoning models productized seamlessly.
turley.zh: 下一个十亿用户需要超越聊天机器人的主动式、富示能产品，并把推理模型无缝产品化。

edwinchen.en: High-quality data and human evals are the real bottleneck; benchmarks like Elo are misleading and can be gamed, so labs should stop publishing insights at their peril.
edwinchen.zh: 高质量数据和人类评估才是真正的瓶颈；Elo 等基准具有误导性且可被操纵，实验室停止发布洞见是巨大错误。

edwinchen.en: RL environments are the next stage of post-training, simulating real-world tasks; models can reward hack, so final reward alone is insufficient.
edwinchen.zh: 强化学习环境是后训练的下一个阶段，模拟真实世界任务；模型可能进行奖励黑客，仅靠最终奖励不够。

edwinchen.en: AGI is likely a decade or more away; LLMs alone may not reach it, and new learning paradigms beyond next-token prediction are needed.
edwinchen.zh: AGI 可能还需十年或更久；仅靠 LLM 可能无法实现，需要超越下一个词预测的新学习范式。

edwinchen.en: In medicine, AI hallucination makes human judgment critical; safety must trump accuracy, and omission may be the biggest risk.
edwinchen.zh: 在医学中，AI 幻觉使人类判断至关重要；安全必须优先于准确性，不作为可能是最大风险。

edwinchen.en: Quality requires taste and sophistication, not just credentials; models will diverge by lab objective functions, and no single model will rule all.
edwinchen.zh: 质量需要品味与 sophistication，而非仅凭资历；模型将因实验室目标函数而分化，不会有单一模型统治一切。

carlpei.en: Building a brand means uniting teams on a higher purpose and executing consistently; survival is a core value, and startups should start simple to prove themselves.
carlpei.zh: 2022 年他强调品牌建设需以更高使命团结团队并持续执行；生存是核心价值，初创公司应从简单产品起步证明自己。

carlpei.en: The future of phones lies in generative UI and proactive, agentic software; AI should be applied to consumer context, and hardware margins are low, so Nothing must evolve beyond hardware.
carlpei.zh: 2025 年他转向认为手机的未来在于生成式 UI 和主动的智能体式软件；AI 应应用于消费者上下文，硬件利润低，Nothing 必须超越硬件。

carlpei.en: Most AI is BS; large language models are commoditized, so focus on user pain points and utility, not AI hype. The smartphone remains the best device for applied AI.
carlpei.zh: 2025 至 2026 年他持续批判多数 AI 是炒作，大语言模型商品化，应聚焦用户痛点与实用性；智能手机仍是应用 AI 的最佳设备。

carlpei.en: Design is the primary differentiator in homogeneous tech; AI will shift smartphones from app-based to intent-based with agents, and privacy may require local or hybrid compute.
carlpei.zh: 2026 年他明确设计是同质化科技中的首要差异化因素；AI 将使手机从基于应用转向基于意图的智能体交互，隐私可能需本地或混合算力。

carlpei.en: Consistent themes: challenger brands need marketing arbitrage and organic content; community and ownership culture; optimism and grit; smartphones won't be replaced by glasses, only brain-computer interfaces.
carlpei.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：挑战者品牌需营销套利和有机内容；社区与主人翁文化；乐观与坚韧；智能手机不会被眼镜取代，只有脑机接口可能。

nando.en: AI should augment human capability like microscopes; generalist agents tokenizing all inputs into sequences are a step toward AGI.
nando.zh: 2023 年，他把 AI 定位为延伸人类能力的工具（如显微镜），并认为把一切输入 token 化为序列的通用智能体是通往 AGI（通用人工智能）的一步。

nando.en: Learning from video and diverse data beats expensive reinforcement learning; innovation can come from anywhere, not just large models.
nando.zh: 从 2023 到 2026 年，他始终主张从视频等多样数据中学习优于昂贵的强化学习，并强调创新可以来自任何地方，而非只有大模型。

nando.en: Diversity and inclusion remain essential; by 2026 he frames Africa as leapfrogging legacy gaps rather than lagging behind.
nando.zh: 多样性与包容性是一贯主线；到 2026 年，他进一步把非洲描述为跨越式跳过历史包袱，而非落后。

nando.en: AI safety and responsible deployment are now the biggest challenges; safety remains an open problem without solutions.
nando.zh: 到 2026 年，他把 AI 安全与负责任部署列为最大挑战，并直言安全仍是尚无解的开放问题。

nando.en: Local-language models can transform African education; human skills like communication matter as much as coding.
nando.zh: 2026 年他深化落地视角：本地语言模型可变革非洲教育，沟通等人文能力与编程同等重要。

sholto.en: Long context windows are underhyped; they solve onboarding and boost intelligence, while fine-tuning may become obsolete.
sholto.zh: 2024 年，他强调长上下文窗口被低估：它能解决“上手”问题并显著提升智能，而微调可能过时。

sholto.en: RL on language models adds a new scaling axis beyond pre-training, with no direct ceiling on intellectual complexity.
sholto.zh: 2025 年，他把语言模型上的强化学习视为预训练之外的新 Scaling（规模扩张）轴，认为智力复杂度没有直接上限。

sholto.en: Agent progress is gated by reliability over time horizon, not raw capability; coding is the leading indicator.
sholto.zh: 2025 年，他反复指出智能体的瓶颈是随时间跨度衡量的可靠性而非能力本身，编程是 AI 进展的领先指标。

sholto.en: Pre-training plus RL may suffice for AGI; no new architecture is needed, though inference compute becomes a bottleneck.
sholto.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，他判断预训练加强化学习或许足以通向 AGI（通用人工智能），无需新架构，但推理算力将成为瓶颈。

sholto.en: Capability overhang means orchestration and compute now matter more; the future is managing fleets of agents.
sholto.zh: 2026 年，他认为能力过剩使编排与算力比单纯智能更重要，未来工作是管理成群的智能体。

jimfan.en: Embodiment is critical for grounding AI and reducing hallucinations; LLMs need grounded experience, not just more pre-training data.
jimfan.zh: 2023 年，他主张具身是让 AI 知识落地、减少幻觉的关键；LLM 需要具身经验，而不仅是更多预训练数据。

jimfan.en: LLMs act like operating systems: language is the interface, tools are software, vector databases are storage; RL is only a cherry on top.
jimfan.zh: 2023 年，他将 LLM 比作操作系统：语言是界面，工具是软件，向量数据库是硬盘；强化学习只是锦上添花。

jimfan.en: From 2023 to 2026, his focus shifted from general embodiment to robotics, where real-world data scarcity is the main bottleneck.
jimfan.zh: 从 2023 到 2026 年，他的关注点从通用具身转向机器人，并指出真实世界数据稀缺是主要瓶颈。

jimfan.en: Synthetic data via simulation and world models is the future for scaling robot learning; a simple end-to-end model leveraging diverse data is key.
jimfan.zh: 2026 年，他认为通过模拟和世界模型生成的合成数据是扩展机器人学习的未来；一个能利用多样数据的简单端到端模型是关键。

jimfan.en: The physical Turing test—a robot cleaning a messy house—is the grand challenge; system one control remains hardest, and the GPT-3 moment for robotics is ~5 years away.
jimfan.zh: 2026 年，他提出物理图灵测试——机器人清理凌乱房间——是重大挑战；系统一的控制仍是最难的，机器人的 GPT-3 时刻大约在 5 年后到来。

yejin.en: Scaling alone may not solve common sense; better inference algorithms and high-quality data can let smaller models outperform larger ones.
yejin.zh: 2023 年她认为单靠 Scaling（规模扩张）未必能解决常识问题，更好的推理算法与高质量数据能让更小的模型在特定任务上超越大模型。

yejin.en: From emphasizing post-training RLHF to identifying data as the fundamental bottleneck; all methods reduce to data.
yejin.zh: 从 2023 年强调后训练与基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF），到 2025 年将数据视为根本瓶颈——所有方法最终都归结为数据。

yejin.en: Current AI interpolates human knowledge; abductive reasoning and exploring unknown knowledge are key to scientific discovery.
yejin.zh: 2025 年她指出当前 AI 只是对人类知识做插值，溯因推理与探索未知知识才是科学发现的关键。

yejin.en: Small language models with diverse synthetic data and RL during pre-training can rival frontier models; pluralistic alignment is essential.
yejin.zh: 2026 年她主张用多样化合成数据与预训练阶段的强化学习，小模型也能比肩前沿模型，并强调多元对齐的必要性。

yejin.en: Open research and pluralistic alignment are consistent threads, opposing proprietary RLHF and closed frontier labs.
yejin.zh: 贯穿始终的主线是开放研究与多元对齐，反对专有的基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）数据和封闭的前沿实验室。

nadchishtie.en: Designers should be enablers, not bottlenecks; AI is a creative partner and code is the source of truth.
nadchishtie.zh: 设计师应成为赋能者而非瓶颈；AI 是创意伙伴，代码是真相来源。

nadchishtie.en: Quality fluctuates like debt; pay it off iteratively with technical debt via rapid experimentation.
nadchishtie.zh: 质量像债务一样波动；通过快速实验与迭代，和技术债一起偿还。

nadchishtie.en: Generalists who own end-to-end execution and use AI to fill gaps are most valuable.
nadchishtie.zh: 能端到端执行并用 AI 填补空缺的通才最有价值。

nadchishtie.en: Small teams of designers and engineers outperform large cross-functional squads; specialist pigeonholing limits growth.
nadchishtie.zh: 设计师与工程师的小团队优于大型跨职能团队；专家标签化限制成长。

nadchishtie.en: Using AI in core workflows is now expected; not adopting it is like ignoring the early internet.
nadchishtie.zh: 在核心工作流中使用 AI 已是常态；不采用它就像早期忽视互联网。

henrymodisett.en: Designers should code for empathy and speed; consumer products must feel fast, familiar, and require zero learning.
henrymodisett.zh: 2024 年，他强调设计师应当会写代码，以建立共情并加快交付；消费级产品必须快、熟悉、零学习成本。

henrymodisett.en: Don't innovate on interaction design; use familiar patterns, and let products grow more powerful without feeling more complex.
henrymodisett.zh: 2024 年，他主张不要在交互设计上创新，应沿用熟悉模式，让产品更强却不显得更复杂。

henrymodisett.en: Velocity at all costs: clear decisions and designer ownership matter more than perfection; chase ROI on what to make great.
henrymodisett.zh: 从 2024 到 2026 年一以贯之的主线是速度至上：清晰决策与设计师自主权比完美更重要，只在值得做好的地方追求回报。

henrymodisett.en: Design is a strategic weapon; founders must articulate why design helps the company win, and brand narrative becomes a recruiting tool.
henrymodisett.zh: 到 2026 年，他把设计深化为战略武器：创始人须讲清设计为何帮公司取胜，品牌叙事则成为招募工具。

henrymodisett.en: Hire diverse archetypes and self-learning interns over clones; prefer organic feedback and gut decisions over structured crits and data.
henrymodisett.zh: 2026 年，他主张招多元类型与自学的实习生而非复制品，偏好有机反馈与直觉决策，而非结构化评审与数据驱动。

leike.en: AI safety needs empirical alignment research; talent gap exceeds funding gap; build skills without over-worrying about capability work.
leike.zh: 2018 年：AI 安全需要实证对齐研究；人才缺口大于资金缺口；应专注技能积累，不必过度担忧能力研究。

leike.en: RLHF won't scale to superhuman AI; scalable oversight and interpretability are key; alignment may be easier than thought since evaluation is easier than generation.
leike.zh: 2023 年：基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）无法扩展到超级智能；可扩展监督和可解释性是关键；对齐可能比想象中容易，因为评估比生成更容易。

leike.en: OpenAI's safety culture eroded; superalignment team dissolved; post-training alone can't solve alignment; third-party testing and regulation like SB 1047 are necessary.
leike.zh: 2024 年：OpenAI 安全文化受损；超级对齐团队解散；仅靠后训练无法解决对齐问题；需要第三方测试和类似 SB 1047 的监管。

truell.en: Scaling laws still drive predictable AI progress; test-time compute scaling may soon surpass pre-training scaling.
truell.zh: 2024 年他仍相信 Scaling（规模扩张）带来可预测进步，并预判测试时算力扩张可能超越预训练成为下一主要驱动力。

truell.en: Agents are promising but not yet super useful; iterative human-AI collaboration stays central.
truell.zh: 2024 年他认为智能体前景可期但尚不实用，人机迭代协作仍是核心。

truell.en: Programming shifts from text to AI-integrated intent specification, with humans in the driver's seat.
truell.zh: 从 2024 到 2025 年，他的编程观从 AI 集成编辑器深化为以人类主导的高层意图表达。

truell.en: Custom models become essential for product quality, speed and cost—an unexpected shift from relying on frontier models.
truell.zh: 2025 年他立场转变：定制模型对产品质量、速度与成本变得不可或缺，出乎意料地不再只依赖前沿模型。

truell.en: Taste and logic design outvalue carefulness; the AI shift exceeds the internet and unfolds over decades.
truell.zh: 2025 年他强调品味与逻辑设计胜过谨慎，并判断 AI 变革超越互联网、需数十年展开。

shazeer.en: LLMs trained on next-token prediction solve an AI-complete problem; Scaling with more compute and data yields smarter AI, though internals remain opaque.
shazeer.zh: 2023 年，他认为基于下一个词预测训练的大语言模型解决的是 AI 完备问题；通过 Scaling（规模扩张）增加算力和数据能让 AI 更聪明，尽管内部机制仍不透明。

shazeer.en: Inference-time compute scaling and longer context windows are major near-term opportunities; modular sparse architectures like mixture of experts enable efficient Scaling.
shazeer.zh: 2025 年初，他提出推理时算力扩展和更长上下文窗口是近期重大机遇；混合专家等模块化稀疏架构能实现高效 Scaling（规模扩张）。

shazeer.en: Test-time compute scaling drives progress but won't alone achieve AGI; agentic capabilities, reinforcement learning, and acting in complex environments are crucial.
shazeer.zh: 2025 年 3 月，他强调测试时算力扩展能推动进步但无法单独实现 AGI（通用人工智能）；智能体式能力、强化学习以及在复杂环境中行动至关重要。

shazeer.en: AGI is underhyped; its economic impact will far exceed trillion-dollar products, and coding as an AI application enables self-acceleration of AI progress.
shazeer.zh: 2025 年，他进一步认为 AGI（通用人工智能）被低估，其经济影响将远超万亿美元级产品，而编码作为 AI 应用能加速 AI 自身的进步。

shazeer.en: Scaling compute and data is the core driver of smarter AI, from pre-training to inference-time and test-time compute scaling.
shazeer.zh: 始终贯穿的主线是：Scaling（规模扩张）算力和数据是 AI 变聪明的核心驱动力，从预训练到推理时及测试时算力扩展。

abbeel.en: Robotics needs hierarchical reasoning for long-horizon credit assignment; current RL lacks it, so self-play and imitation learning fill the gap.
abbeel.zh: 2018 年，他强调机器人需要分层推理来完成长程信用分配，而当时的强化学习做不到，因此靠自我博弈与模仿学习补足。

abbeel.en: Prior knowledge should generate or augment data, not be hard-coded; this evolves from simulation ensembles to unsupervised learning plus RL.
abbeel.zh: 从 2018 到 2021 年，他一贯主张先验知识应用于数据生成或增强而非硬编码，并从仿真集成深化为无监督学习结合强化学习。

abbeel.en: Pre-trained language models internalize general reasoning that transfers to non-language tasks, anticipating today's scaling and pre-training 主线.
abbeel.zh: 2021 年，他指出预训练语言模型内化了可迁移到非语言任务的通用推理模式，这成为后来 Scaling（规模扩张）与预训练主线的先声。

abbeel.en: Real-world value demands 99.9% reliability; a single network generalizes across warehouse tasks and end effectors, shifting focus from lab to deployment.
abbeel.zh: 2021 年，他把重心从实验室转向落地：真实价值要求 99.9% 可靠性，单一网络可跨仓库任务与末端执行器泛化。
